Located in the upscale Eixample District in the heart of Barcelona, Galderma’s Global Capability Center offers numerous possibilities for professional development such as exposure to global and cross\-functional projects and access to global career opportunities.


**Location: Barcelona or London**

  

**Summary**  

  

Galderma is seeking to reinforce its world\-class industrial capacities through the implementation of a global end\-to\-end lean supply and manufacturing program. Within this framework, we are seeing an experienced Global Head of Operations Excellence to develop, set the pace and accelerate our Operations transformational and continuous improvement strategy with sensitivity towards the organizational structure, culture, people and processes.  



Working with Operations functions, and their embedded excellence resources, including Supply Chain, Quality, External Supply, Industrial Development and Plant leadership, you will coordinate and prioritize the required support for the entire Industrial Operations organization and will ensure standardization, where appropriate, in liaison with the other leaders. Knowledge sharing and communication of best practices will also be a key component of this position across Galderma.  

  



**About The Role**

As Global Head of Operations Excellence, reporting to the Global Head of Operations, you will drive knowledge sharing across the organization by establishing key practitioner groups focused on continuous end to end improvements and convergence on identified best practices. By creating collaboration across departments and functions throughout the Operations organization you will ensure alignment of strategy and tactics for successful excellence implementation.  



You will be responsible for the design, development and implementation of our global lean supply and manufacturing program with the intent to establish linkage and flow, meet customer demand at lowest cost with perfect quality, consolidate rationalization and enhance organizational agility.  



You will be the primary architect and leader of our Operations Excellence Transformation and as such will work to establish programs, practices metrics and standards utilizing lean methodologies, analyze and recommend future state value stream design and also identify opportunities to improve existing practices, procedures and processes toward true north vision. You will lead and mentor leaders and multi\-functional teams to implement a standardized excellence methodology to ensure consistent and rigorous application across the business in line with best practice.  



Based in Barcelona or London, the position holder will be a member of our Operations Leadership Team, and partner closely with various department to collaborate on all aspects of the company's Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing/Procurement and Supply Chain strategies.  



**Core Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and implement Galderma’s end\-to\-end Operations Excellence transformation strategy and deploy a program for lean development across our global supply, industrial and manufacturing footprint including coordination of our drive to 85% Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE)
* Continuously structure, coordinate and update the Operations function annual strategy plan through a clear methodology based on the Hoshin process including dashboard accountability for all Operations functions.
* Conduct Extended Value Stream Baseline analysis, Supplier summit and Kaizen events with site and function leaders to improve performance in the identified areas requiring lean/kaizen support. Provide high level, lean master/sensei support to help build capability and ensure required event objectives are achieved. In addition to that, responsible for progressing lean continuous Improvement (CI) and lean culture penetration.
* Pilot Operations’ evaluation of performance, rationalization and agility through cross functional dashboard ownership and reporting.
* Utilize, drive and promote understanding of Lean and Six\-Sigma tools and principals to ensure the delivery of business objectives and a culture of continuous improvement; develop and implement improvement plans, facilitate daily visual management, lean conversion and root cause and corrective action (RCCA)
* Provide expertise, professional advice and guidance to the business in business improvement, drawing from proven industry practice and methodologies
* Work collaboratively, negotiate and engage with key stakeholders to facilitate delivery and compliance with the Lean strategy
* Communicate with stakeholders the impact of market change and potential effects on Lean methodologies. Recommend solutions without compromising quality or service while optimizing cost
* Effectively coach teams to manage for daily performance using visual controls
* Mentor using Gemba walks and other lead standard work toolkits.
* Coach employees to see abnormal conditions and problem solve systematically
* Lead kaizen events to bring Operations to standard, or improve work performance toward true north
* Ensure 5S/RCCA is taught, implemented and adhered throughout the organization.
Coordinate, schedule and facilitate as applicable Lean/Six Sigma activities to enhance cross\-functional problems solving; utilize Company tool champions as appropriate for more significant lean events  
* 

**About You**

* Solid experience in highly performing manufacturing structures operating at 85%\+ OEE.
* Involvement building and leading successful projects and programs with an understanding of the tactics needed for execution, including overall upskilling and upscaling of manufacturing performance.
* Ambitious, entrepreneurial approach to finding new growth levers for the business
* Outstanding executive presence and presentation skills, with the ability to inspire and engage executives
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple work streams at once
* Exceptional critical thinking and ability to professionally advance others’ understanding of lean metrics and goals
* Result and customer focused with a successful record of accomplishments through skilled use of influence, persuasion, negotiation and resolution
* Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate projects status needs across different levels of the organization and different operating environments
* Determined focused leader; ability to quickly establish credibility throughout the organization by effectively balancing strategic as well as on\-going operations \& execution levels
* Highly collaborative with ability to lead through influence in a matrixed environment
* Relationship builder and can hold people accountable while making them feel energized about the road ahead
* Anticipate the needs of teammates, give and get all the facts making it easy for all to make decisions
Mastery is expected but not limited to JIT, takt, flow, pull, standard work sheet, Jidoka, DMAIC, A3, policy deployment, Toyota production system, TPM, continuous flow, continuous improvement, error proofing, eliminating waste, 5 why’s, heijunka, Kanban, kaizen, linearity, pacemaker, pitch, replenishment system, SWIP, supermarket, standardized work, standard work combo sheet, value stream mapping, visual management.  
* 

**Requirements**

* Automotive or cost oriented company experience preferred
* Background in people management, project management and digital transformation

AI Science \& Innovation (AISI) sits at the centre of AstraZeneca's R\&D AI transformation. Our remit is to build, buy and deliver the AI models and agents that change pipeline outcomes, across discovery, translational science, biomarkers and clinical development.


Drug discovery has benefitted enormously in the current AI era, yet comprises only a portion of the journey to bring new treatments to those in need. The final step – clinical drug development – is oft overlooked, despite requiring a significant proportion of time and investment. In the AI for Clinical Development team at AstraZeneca, we're reimagining the process of clinical development. Our vision is to bring safe, efficacious treatments to patients in a way that quantifiably improves our chance to do this faster, more cost\-effectively, and with reduced patient burden.


In this role, you will be a senior technical and strategic lead to help us leverage the power of AI to the fullest, alongside our other computational, statistical, and machine learning tools. You will work across the enterprise to define and deliver on AstraZeneca’s most pressing clinical development questions. You will proactively collaborate in cross\-functional teams spanning AstraZeneca’s key Oncology foci of hematology, cell therapy, antibody\-drug conjugates, small molecules, and biologics. This is an unprecedented, high visibility opportunity to invent new ways to leverage data, models, and learnings across the spectrum of cancer biology and drug modalities – and importantly, you and the team will apply these new methods to measurably advance the late\-stage drug pipeline and our group’s ambition.

* Define and drive the AI strategy and roadmap for Oncology early and late phase clinical development, and align AI/ML priorities with clinical and business objectives

* Evaluate, develop, and champion cutting\-edge AI methods, end\-to\-end, including problem definition, data considerations, governance, algorithm development, validation, and adoption
* Build cross\-functional relationships with clinical development, biometrics, regulatory, and study teams to embed AI strategy and validated solutions into clinical study design, execution, strategy, and decision\-making
* Establish and maintain external collaborations with academic institutions, technology partners, and industry consortia to access novel capabilities and advance the AI roadmap
* Represent AstraZeneca at scientific conferences, standards bodies, and peer\-reviewed venues; contribute first\- or last\-author publications in leading ML and clinical AI journals
* Establish best practices; help shape and promote team culture
* Mentor and support more junior level scientists within the team

* 4\-8 years’ work experience outside of PhD with measurable impact (e.g. models delivered, patents, SaMD filings, first\-author publications, open\-source projects, standards\-body participation)

**Technical requirements**


* Exceptional software development and coding skills, leveraging frontier coding agent frameworks; knowledge of computing hardware a plus
* Deep experience, knowledge, and understanding of one or more fields of biology
* Deep understanding of machine learning fundamentals, with domain expertise in one or more of the following
* Training and tuning foundation models
* Bayesian inference
* Temporal modeling
* Multimodal integration and modeling
* Model calibration and domain adaptation

* Model and data evaluations and benchmarking
* Model interpretability

* Experience working with biological data such as molecular (e.g. DNA, RNA, protein), imaging (radiology, microscopy), or clinical text (e.g. EHR, clinical notes)

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**About Darkroom**


Darkroom is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a **Social Media Manager** to own day\-to\-day social strategy and execution across a portfolio of client accounts. You live inside culture and platforms — you know what's working, why it's working, and how to translate that into a content calendar that builds real communities, not just posting schedules. You're equally comfortable briefing in a creative team, jumping into the comments to manage community, and sitting across from a client explaining why a strategy shift makes sense.


You'll work closely with Associate Directors and Directors of Creative Strategy to build out the social calendar, brief creative execution that feels inventive rather than templated, and manage the client relationship day to day — all while keeping the account organized and operating smoothly.

***This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).***

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day\-to\-day creative execution for organic social programs across a portfolio of client accounts
* Partner with the Director of Creative Strategy to build out the social media calendar and plan
* Brief and direct Designers and Editors on inventive, culturally\-relevant statics, motion, video, carousels, and Stories, giving clear, actionable feedback on hooks, pacing, and edit structure
* Lead community management in a way that actively builds community, not just responds to it
* Write copy for social posts, flexing tone and voice by platform and client
* Work alongside the creator team on UGC briefs and execution
* Translate platform and performance data (hook retention, watch time, CTR, engagement rate, saves, follower growth) into clear creative and content direction
* Maintain quality and consistency across a high volume of social creative output, flagging risk to timelines or scope early
* Manage the day\-to\-day client relationship — communication, updates, and expectations
* Keep the account organized operationally — timelines, deliverables, and workflow

**You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You**

* 3\+ years of experience building "worlds" on social — brands with a distinct voice and engaged community, not just a content calendar
* Fluent in social media metrics and know how to read them into decisions
* A deep, current understanding of culture and how it moves social — not just what's trending, but why
* Extremely up to date on algorithm changes and platform shifts across Meta, TikTok, and Instagram
* Strong grasp of the briefing process — you know how to brief creative that's actually inventive
* Experience using Sprout Social or a similar social management platform
* Already using AI tools thoughtfully in your workflow — you know where they help and where they don't
* Experience in product, beauty, fashion, SaaS, tech, or hospitality preferred, but not required

**Hard Disqualifiers**

* No experience owning social accounts
* No experience running community management
* Strategy\-only with no execution ability
* Not comfortable presenting work to clients

### **What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

### **Equal Opportunity Statement**


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)
description:
Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)
=========================================

 **Location:** Remote. Continental Europe or compatible time zone preferred. (roughly UTC\-1 to UTC\+3\)

**Clients:** Global. Primarily EMEA and North American.

**Reports to:** VP of Solutions

**Salary Range:** $80,000 \- $150,000 USD annually, plus bonus/commission based on acquisition and growth of client accounts. Compensation dependent on candidate experience and location.

  

About McGaw

**Our Mission at McGaw.io is to help companies of all sizes realize their customer data is their most valuable business asset, and we help them realize that through customer data infrastructure, high power analytics, marketing automation, personalization, and funnel optimization.**


McGaw.io supports businesses with analytics, marketing automation, customer data platforms, data piping, websites, AB testing, and all sorts of marketing operations. As we derive insights from these technical efforts, we also inform \& execute growth strategies that routinely move the needle for our clients.


Our track record is impeccable, and our leadership has supported some of the fastest\-growing companies in the world. McGaw.io’s core client base sells online and has complex data and marketing practices that drive our team to dig deeper every day.

Mission
-------


Own a portfolio of client relationships. Set the strategy, keep accounts healthy and profitable, grow them, win new ones, and get the technical work delivered through the team rather than by doing it yourself.

Why this role exists
--------------------


Accounts need a senior owner accountable for whether they renew and whether they grow. Outside North America that accountability sits in the wrong time zone, so the client's executive sponsor talks to us at the end of their day and the relationship runs a meeting behind.


This is the commercial and strategic owner. It is not the technical builder.


Three problems this role solves:

* Nobody outside North America is accountable for account health, retention, and expansion.
* Executive conversations happen at inconvenient hours, so they happen less often.
* Expansion is reactive. Nobody plans the next six months before the current scope runs out, and nobody runs discovery in European hours.

Responsibilities
----------------

**Relationship ownership**

* Own the relationship at executive level. You are who the client's CMO or VP of Growth calls.
* Run the cadence: biweekly client meetings, monthly roadmap and SOW reviews, quarterly business reviews covering results, maturity, next quarter, and risks.
* Keep the client informed before they have to ask. Never surprise them on budget or timeline.

 **Strategy and consulting**

* Find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention. Map every problem to pain, metric, impact, and fix.
* Build and defend the growth roadmap with the client, not at them.
* Do the strategic hands\-on work yourself: measurement frameworks, KPI definition, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle program design, experiment roadmaps, readouts.
* Translate technical decisions into business consequences the client can act on.

 **Delegation and project leadership**

* Scope the work, then hand it to architects and engineers with enough detail that it gets built right.
* Manage the project, not the build. Sprint cadence, board hygiene, dependencies, risks, critical path.
* Review delivered work against the client's objectives before it ships. You are not the QA engineer, but you are accountable for whether the client got what they were told they would get.
* Know enough to challenge an estimate and spot a bad technical answer. You do not write the code.

 **New business**

* Run pre\-sales discovery. Qualify hard, and say no when a prospect is not ready.
* Build and present proposals: scope, phasing, investment, and the business case. Presented live, never sent cold.
* Price work so it delivers profitably. A generous estimate at proposal is a delivery problem in month three.
* Work with Sales through qualification, discovery, and close, then take the account into delivery.

 **Commercial**

* Own retention and expansion on your portfolio. You are measured on both.
* Every scope change gets estimated, documented, and confirmed in writing before work starts.
* Run the six\-month roadmap cycle so the next engagement is signed before the current one ends.

Skills and experience
---------------------

**Required**

* Fully fluent in English. That is the company's working language.
* Multilingual with professional working proficiency in English as well as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
* 10\+ years in consulting, agency, or professional services. At least 5 owning senior client relationships with a revenue number attached.
* Understand the full marketing lifecycle: demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, and where revenue leaks between the stages.
* Understand how martech drives marketing, from ads to CDPs to marketing engagement platforms, CRM, and analytics.
* Advise on the systems below: which to use, how they fit together, the tradeoffs, and how to get more from what a client already owns. You do not configure them. You do need to be right about them, and to spot a bad technical answer when you are given one.
* Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and how to leverage data to improve marketing returns.
* Track record retaining and expanding accounts, with figures a former manager would confirm.
* Pre\-sales experience: discovery, scoping, writing proposals, and presenting them to executive buyers.
* Scope and price technical work profitably.
* Know how European businesses buy, contract, and operate across markets, including procurement, data protection, and consent.

 **Systems.** Advisory command of these. Depth in at least three groups.

* Customer data platforms: Segment, Hightouch, RudderStack
* Analytics: Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4
* Lifecycle and marketing automation: Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Iterable
* Warehouse and transformation: Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt
* Tag management: Google Tag Manager, server\-side GTM
* CRM: Salesforce, HubSpot
* Consent management: OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi

 **Preferred**

* Accounts across multiple countries or regulatory regimes.
* Work across both European and North American clients.
* Built or seeded a regional practice before.

What you get out of this
------------------------

* You own the full commercial arc of an account, from discovery through renewal and expansion. At a larger firm that is three people's jobs.
* The customer data layer is changing right now. Warehouse\-native patterns, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL are replacing a decade of assumptions. You advise on the new pattern while most of the market still sells the old one.
* We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors. That includes telling a client when they already have what they need.
* Many industries and stacks in a year instead of one in five, on both sides of the Atlantic.

Observable indicators
---------------------

**Month 2**

* Onboarded onto your accounts, each with a current\-state assessment and named client objectives.
* Time tracked in Harvest weekly, without reminders.
* Every account's decision\-maker has met you and knows what you own.

**Month 4**

* Running your accounts independently: meetings, roadmap reviews, budget conversations, scope changes.
* Every account has three or more months of planned roadmap.
* Zero undocumented scope changes.
* Technical work delegated with specs good enough that it does not come back for rework.
* Running discovery calls and contributing to proposals.

**Month 6**

* 90% of client objectives hit within the project timeline.
* Labor efficiency ratio of 3\.0 across your portfolio.
* Client approval for a case study or testimonial on at least one account.
* Writing and presenting proposals independently.

**Month 9**

* 80% retention of your accounts in recurring contracts over a rolling three months.
* 20% of your retainers expanded over a rolling 90 days.
* Your proposals deliver at or above target labor efficiency. Your estimates hold up.
* Representing McGaw independently in sales and partner meetings.

What this role is not
---------------------

* Not a hands\-on build seat although you will get into the tools if you need to.
* Not a prospecting seat. You run discovery, write and present proposals, own retention and expansion, and earn commission on it. You do not cold prospect.
* Not a people management seat at hire. You direct a project team. Managing a team comes later, if the business grows and you have shown you can.

Values
------

* Never Settle, Be Amazing. Fix it properly, not just enough to close the ticket.
* Get Better Every Day. Ask for feedback and change what you do when you get it.
* Give Context and Set the Stage. Nobody on your account is surprised by what you already knew.
* Let the Data Create Transparency. Recommendations come with evidence. So does bad news.
* Show Hospitality to Build Trust. Clients and teammates get proactive, responsive treatment.


Plus extreme ownership. Own the outcome, surface blockers early, and never hand a problem back to the person who gave it to you.

Benefits
--------

* Flexible PTO
* Flexible hours
* Work remotely
* Monthly per diem for premium health, dental, and vision coverage if not already available
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Retirement contribution of 3% of salary annually.
* Company laptop, monitor, and remote setup equipment
* National holidays off.
* Radically transparent workplace
* Room to act on your own ideas

The job in practice
-------------------


McGaw is a customer data and revenue operations consultancy. Clients come to us with traffic, tools, and data, and no system connecting them. We find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention, then we fix it with our hands on the keyboards.


The CDP is the center of most of our work. We build on Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack, chosen per client. We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors.


Our clients are in North America and Europe. Your portfolio will be a mix.

**Month 1\.** Learn our clients, delivery model, and commercial standards. Meet every stakeholder on your accounts. Shadow client meetings, QBRs, and pre\-sales calls.

**Months 2 and 3\.** Take ownership of your accounts. Run the meetings, rebuild the roadmaps, take over the budget conversations. An experienced account owner stays close.

**Months 4 to 6\.** Run your portfolio independently. Hit your labor efficiency target. Start running discovery and writing proposals.

**After 6 months.** You own the commercial arc on your accounts, from first discovery call through renewal. You help define what the next hires look like.

**What is hard.** You are accountable for delivery you did not perform, done mostly by people in another time zone. Managing that gap is most of the job. Pre\-sales competes with delivery, and both are urgent. Work is billable by the hour, so time tracking is not optional. Expansion targets are real and measured.

title: Associate Director - Health Technology Assessment - Home-based or hybrid from any EU country
description:
Madrid, Spain \| Full time \| Hybrid \| R1567249  
This job is available in the UK and in EU countries. Don't hesitate to apply if you're interested either in the UK or in any EU country, even if not all of them are listed.  


The team  
IQVIA is a fast\-growing and highly successful consultancy business, focusing on delivering tangible business results to our clients who are key decision\-makers and business managers across the international pharmaceutical and healthcare industry. With direct access to the world's most comprehensive healthcare information, analytic and research resources, IQVIA experts design and deliver innovative, data\- and technology\-enabled evidence programmes for the pharmaceutical industry. We apply scientific rigour and advanced analytics to real\-world data to help our clients improve healthcare.  


The IQVIA Global Health Economics and HTA team includes highly qualified multi\-disciplinary professionals in a variety of health economics, statistics, life sciences and epidemiology\-related disciplines based across multiple geographies worldwide. We help our customers design and execute an evidence generation strategy meeting payer and health technology assessment (HTA) evidence requirements and effectively communicate their product's value story.  


Our clients operate in the life sciences industry, including the global top 20 pharmaceutical companies, medical device and biotech companies, as well as public health providers and regulatory authorities. They are looking for insight and evidence around the safety, efficacy, effectiveness and cost\-effectiveness of healthcare delivery systems, medical devices, and pharmaceutical products spanning the full spectrum of therapeutic and disease areas. Our diverse mix of clients, the breadth of disease areas, as well as increasing access to novel data sources and methodologies provide a constant and rewarding challenge for our people.  


For more information about our company please visit our website: https://www.iqvia.com/  


Associate Director in Health Technology Assessment Strategy and Implementation  


Role Overview  


This is a senior leadership role within the Global Health Economics and HTA team, with a focus on health technology assessment (HTA), market access and strategic offerings. The Associate Principal will lead complex client engagements, develop senior client relationships, contribute to business growth, shape future service offerings and support the development of the HTA practice. The successful candidate will:  


Act as a senior strategic advisor to pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device clients on HTA evidence planning, market access strategy and reimbursement optimisation.  
Lead the design and delivery of complex, high\-value global and regional HTA programmes, with limited senior oversight.  
Guide clients through evolving HTA requirements, including EU Joint Clinical Assessments, national HTA submissions, early scientific advice, evidence planning and reimbursement processes.  
Shape and evolve IQVIA’s HTA consulting offerings in collaboration with the Centre of Excellence for HTA Evidence and Strategy and the wider senior leadership team.  
Identify emerging HTA and market access trends and translate them into relevant, innovative client solutions.  
Develop and maintain senior\-level client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor and identifying opportunities to expand existing accounts and build new relationships.  
Support HTA\-related business development opportunities, which may include supporting proposal development, scope definition, pricing and contract discussions, with appropriate senior input.  
Provide executive oversight across multiple concurrent projects and programmes, ensuring scientific quality, strategic relevance, client satisfaction and commercial performance.  
Lead senior client discussions, steering committee interactions, problem solving, negotiation and risk mitigation across complex engagements.  
Work collaboratively across internal IQVIA teams, including technical consultants responsible for generating HTA evidence and complementary functions such as Market Access, Patient\-Centered Solutions, HTA Accelerator Solutions, database studies and local teams across the globe.  
Act as a role model, coach and mentor for consultants, senior consultants and emerging leaders, creating opportunities that support their career development as HTA specialists.  
Support recruitment, onboarding, performance management, succession planning and capability development across the team.  
Provide formal line management responsibilities, as appropriate.  
Lead and contribute to thought leadership on HTA topics, including conference abstracts and posters, white papers, peer\-reviewed publications and external presentations.  
Represent IQVIA at relevant industry conferences, scientific meetings, client forums and other external events.  


The demand for IQVIA’s HTA offerings continues to expand in response to evolving HTA processes across the globe. The Associate Principal will play an important role in shaping the team’s strategy, client portfolio, people and HTA offerings, while having opportunities to expand their portfolio into other areas if desired.  


The successful candidate  


We are looking for a candidate with a strong combination of academic and professional experience, deep HTA domain expertise, commercial acumen, leadership capability and interpersonal skills. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with translating clinical data to support a product value proposition within the context of regional / national HTA submissions and early HTA scientific advice, as well as a proven record of navigating HTA processes strategically to optimise product access, reimbursement and value communication.  


The ideal candidate will understand the organisational structures and decision\-making processes typical of pharmaceutical and life sciences clients, and will be able to influence senior stakeholders, lead multidisciplinary teams and translate complex evidence challenges into clear strategic recommendations.  


The list below should be viewed as a guide rather than a checklist.  


Qualifications and desired experience:  


Postgraduate degree level education or higher in a relevant discipline, such as HTA, health economics, economics, life sciences, epidemiology, biostatistics, public health, medicine, pharmacy, etc. AND typically, 8 or more years of relevant experience in consulting, the pharmaceutical sector, an HTA agency, academia or a related environment.  
Extensive experience preparing evidence strategies and submissions aligned with HTA processes and requirements in the UK and/or Europe, together with involvement in appraisal, scientific advice or negotiation processes where relevant.  
Demonstrated success in managing complex client engagements, multidisciplinary teams and portfolios of projects.  
A strong commercial track record, including client relationship development, proposal leadership, scope and budget development, and contribution to business generation.  
Demonstrable commercial awareness and a thorough understanding of the pharmaceutical and life sciences industry; an established network of HEOR, HTA or market access contacts is highly desirable.  
Strong people leadership, coaching and capability\-development skills; previous line management experience is desirable.  
Strategic thinking and attention to detail.  
Previous experience in a consultancy environment is highly desirable.  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English. Applications should be submitted in English.  
Strong understanding of the design of clinical trials, statistical methods used in clinical trials, and methodology for evidence synthesis is highly desirable.  
Quantitative skills, including biostatistics and health economic modelling methods and good knowledge of statistical software packages (e.g., STATA, R) is highly desirable.  


Our commitment to you  


IQVIA are committed to your professional growth in the healthcare industry. You will join a team of professionals working as subject matter experts, representing multiple disciplines, including HTA, health economic modelling, evidence synthesis, literature reviews, epidemiology, biostatistics, and data management.  


During the first three months, new joiners are supported with a structured onboarding programme to ensure a smooth transition into the team and the wider organisation. The organisational structure of the team ensures that each team member can have regular 1:1 meetings with their line manager. These meetings range from goal setting to advice for projects; the common theme is to provide personalised development support.  


IQVIA offers numerous training opportunities. You will have opportunities for external trainings aligned with business and team objectives. IQVIA also offers unlimited access to eLearning courses on LinkedIn Learning and Learning Edge as well as access to our internal training courses.  


You will be rewarded with a competitive salary, bonus, and benefits. You will have the opportunity to gain invaluable and transferable experience within an innovative team with a global footprint. Your new role offers flexibility, including remote working and occasional office visits.  


IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com  


IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.  


Where you'll work  
Hybrid  


You’ll split your time between home and the office, giving you the flexibility to focus where you work best while still building strong in\-person connections with your team. This model combines the autonomy of remote work with the collaboration, energy and resources of an office environment.  
Culture  


Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

title: Lead Product Manager - RPG
description:
**Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love.** We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top\-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.  

  

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built\-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass\-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.  

  

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.  

  

What powers the loop is talent density. 220\+ people from 30\+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.  

  

At Homa, we are building the next billion\-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**Mission**As a **Lead Product Manager** on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end\-to\-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.


Your main responsibilities will include:

* **Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles:** core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in\-game economy.
* **Own LiveOps end\-to\-end.** You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
* **Lead your team.** You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
* **Oversee the monetization model.** Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
* **Drive growth, in partnership with UA.** You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand\-in\-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
* **Cross\-functional excellence.** You'll work hand\-in\-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end\-to\-end, from concept to launch.
* **Set the bar.** Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
* **Stay hands\-on when it counts.** This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.


This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

 **Requirements**  

We are looking for someone with **several years of product experience on live mobile games, especially RPG,** with genuine end\-to\-end ownership of an economy, progression system or monetization roadmap, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

**Product \& RPG expertise**

* P**roduct experience on live F2P mobile games**, ideally RPG/midcore, with end\-to\-end ownership of major features, progression, monetization or product roadmaps.
* Strong fluency in **RPG mechanics and meta systems:** progression, power curves, collection, PvP/social, seasons and passes, and strong mobile marketability instincts.
* Ideally, you’ve taken a title **from concept/pre\-launch through launch and LiveOps**, or shaped product direction across multiple titles.

**LiveOps \& Execution**

* Deep **LiveOps experience**, understanding how events, content, progression and monetization work together to drive engagement and repeat spend.
* Strong track record **owning features end\-to\-end**: identify, build, ship, measure and iterate, with a practical understanding of **what a live team can realistically ship and maintain**, balancing ambition with feasibility.

**Leadership \& Ways of working**

* Strong **cross\-functional leadership**, able to align Design, Publishing, Data, Economy, UA, Growth and external studios around the product direction.
* A **strategist and builder**: able to set direction and lead others, while remaining highly hands\-on with the game, systems and data.
* Thrives in **lean, fast\-moving, high\-autonomy teams** with quick tests, short feedback loops and high ownership

**Our Culture**
At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

* **Ambition**: We strive for the best \- we don’t settle for “good enough.”
* **Humility**: We recognize that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
* **Curiosity**: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what”.
* **Focus**: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider \- we dive deep into the details.

  

**Benefits**  

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
* **Paris HQ Access:** Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well\-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
* **Coworking Access:** You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
* **Global Team:** Collaborate in English with top\-tier talent from 35\+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
* ✈️ **Team Gatherings:** We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off\-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
* **Performance Reviews:** We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
* **Equipment Support:** From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.


Where We Hire
Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after\-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy \- all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).


We also have incredible team members across Europe \- from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC\+3\). If you're based there \- or planning to be \- we’d love to hear from you!

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
We have a demand generation and expansion engine that's already running. What we need now is someone who can design the campaign strategies behind it, make the commercial trade\-off decisions that determine where we invest, and take ownership of the outcomes across the full customer lifecycle.



This is a strategic digital marketing role for someone who doesn't just run campaigns — you design them. You decide what we run, why we run it, where we spend, and what we stop doing. You will own the strategic planning and optimization of global digital campaigns — from paid media and nurture programs to ABM plays and customer expansion campaigns — making the calls on channel mix, audience strategy, and budget allocation that determine whether our marketing investment converts into pipeline and revenue.



You will sit within the Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, and working closely with Digital Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Content and Creative. This role strengthens the strategic engine of our demand generation and expansion motion — you're the person who decides what campaigns we build, how we structure them, and where we make trade\-offs to maximize commercial impact across acquisition and growth.



If you're a digital strategist who designs campaign architectures rather than just executing them, makes data\-informed trade\-off decisions with confidence, understands that marketing's job doesn't stop at the closed deal, and wants to be a key contributor in a high\-performing growth team — this is your role.


**What you'll work on**


**Campaign strategy and design**


* Design the strategic framework for global multi\-channel digital campaigns — defining audience strategy, channel mix, sequencing, and budget allocation across paid search, paid social, display, email, and content syndication to hit pipeline and expansion targets
* Make commercial trade\-off decisions on where to invest and where to pull back — you're expected to analyze performance, identify diminishing returns, and reallocate spend and effort based on what's actually driving outcomes
* Define campaign architectures across the full bow\-tie — designing how campaigns work together from awareness and lead generation through to nurture, conversion, and customer expansion, not just launching them one at a time
* Brief the Content and Creative team on what's needed and why — setting clear strategic direction for campaign assets based on audience insight, channel requirements, and commercial goals


**Account\-based marketing strategy and execution**


* Design and execute digital ABM campaign strategies targeting named accounts and account segments — defining the engagement model, channel approach, and success criteria in collaboration with the enterprise and sales teams
* Architect multi\-touch ABM plays that blend paid media, personalized content, email sequences, and retargeting — making deliberate decisions about where to invest across new logo and expansion opportunities
* Stay current on the latest ABM tactics, platforms, and approaches — from intent data providers and programmatic ABM to personalization at scale — and make recommendations on what Duetto should adopt, test, or stop doing
* Define ABM measurement frameworks at the account level — tracking engagement, pipeline influence, and progression rather than just lead volume, and using those insights to reshape strategy


**Nurture, conversion, and expansion strategy**


* Design and optimize nurture strategies across both acquisition and expansion — deciding what workflows we run, how they're structured, and where we need to fix friction across the full bow\-tie
* Define the campaign strategy for customer expansion — designing upsell, cross\-sell, and adoption campaigns that support the commercial goals of the customer success and sales teams, not just repeating acquisition tactics
* Make data\-informed decisions on where to focus conversion optimization effort — prioritizing the stages and segments where improvements will have the greatest commercial impact
* Own the analysis of campaign and channel performance — turning data into strategic recommendations on what to change, scale, or retire across the full lifecycle


**Regional strategy and localization**


* Define how global campaign strategies should be adapted for local markets — making decisions on where to localize messaging, creative, and channel strategy versus where to maintain global consistency
* Provide strategic performance analysis by territory that helps regional teams and leadership understand what digital marketing is delivering — and what needs to change — across both demand generation and expansion


**MarTech and data operations**


* Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the marketing technology stack — making recommendations on how to improve integration between campaign platforms, CRM, and lead routing systems
* Ensure campaign infrastructure supports the strategic ambitions of the growth team — you're the person who sees where the tech is limiting execution and makes the case for fixing it
* Champion clean data practices and campaign hygiene — because the quality of strategic decisions depends on a database you can trust


**AI\-first campaign operations**


* Use AI as a core part of how you design, plan, and optimize campaign strategies — from audience research and competitive analysis to performance modeling and scenario planning
* Bring an AI\-native mindset to campaign strategy — always asking how automation, smarter tooling, and agentic workflows can raise the quality and speed of strategic decision\-making, not just execution
* Contribute to how the Growth Marketing team adopts AI in day\-to\-day work — testing new approaches, sharing what works, and helping build practices that make the whole team faster and sharper
* Treat AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut — the bar for strategic quality, targeting precision, and commercial impact stays high regardless of the tools used


**What we're looking for**


**Experience**


* 5\+ years in digital marketing, growth marketing, or marketing operations — with demonstrable experience designing campaign strategies that have driven measurable pipeline and expansion revenue, not just executing plans built by others
* Demonstrable experience designing and owning digital ABM campaign strategies — defining targeting, engagement models, and measurement frameworks for named accounts or account segments
* Proven ability to make commercial trade\-off decisions across paid media, email, nurture, and content syndication — you know how to read performance data and decide where to invest, scale, or cut
* Experience designing marketing campaigns across both acquisition and customer expansion — you understand the bow\-tie and know how to architect campaigns that drive growth on both sides of it
* Experience with marketing technology platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, and programmatic/ABM tools — you understand the strategic possibilities and limitations of the stack, not just how to operate it
* Background in B2B SaaS preferred — but strong strategic thinking and commercial instinct matter more than sector match


**Skills and capabilities**


* Strong campaign strategist — you design campaign architectures, define audience and channel strategies, and make the decisions that shape what gets built and launched
* Data\-informed decision maker — you don't just report on performance, you interpret it, draw conclusions, and make strategic recommendations that change what the team does next
* Commercially minded — you understand that every campaign decision is a trade\-off and you make those trade\-offs with pipeline and revenue outcomes in mind
* Clear communicator — able to present strategic recommendations, brief creative teams with precision, and articulate the rationale behind campaign decisions to senior stakeholders
* Curious and proactive — you stay ahead of what's changing in digital marketing and bring strategic recommendations to the team without being asked


**How you operate**


* You think about campaigns in terms of pipeline contribution and expansion revenue, not just clicks and impressions
* You're a strategist who ships — you design campaigns with commercial intent and then make sure they get executed at the standard you set
* You're comfortable with complexity — balancing multiple campaign strategies across multiple channels, regions, and commercial objectives at the same time
* You understand the bow\-tie — you see acquisition and expansion as two halves of the same commercial motion and design campaign strategies accordingly
* You embrace AI as part of how you work — using it to think faster and make better strategic decisions, not as a replacement for judgment


**What success looks like in year one**


* Campaign strategies in place across acquisition and expansion that are clearly driving measurable pipeline contribution and revenue
* ABM campaign strategies running against named accounts with defined engagement models and account\-level progression metrics — not just awareness impressions
* Nurture and expansion strategies optimized with measurable improvements in conversion rates across both sides of the bow\-tie — based on trade\-off decisions you made and can evidence
* Clean, strategic campaign reporting that gives leadership and regional teams confidence in where digital marketing is delivering and where investment should shift
* You are a key strategic contributor the Growth Marketing team relies on — trusted by the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, the wider growth team, and the sales function as someone who designs what we do and owns the outcomes


**About Duetto**



Duetto is the Revenue and Profit Operating System for the global hospitality industry — a PE\-backed SaaS business with customers across hotels, casinos, and hospitality groups worldwide. We're building a marketing function that matches our ambition: world\-class, commercially driven, and genuinely category\-defining.

title: Senior SEO Content Strategist - B2B Growth

You'll own our content strategy end to end and report directly to our Head of Marketing. * Dig into analytics to understand what's actually performing and why, then replicate it

Nice to have* Experience creating localized/international content (EMEA/MENA/GCC markets)
* Familiarity with remote work, HR, payroll, or compliance topics

  

**Benefits**  

  

Why Join RemotePass?* Remote\-First Culture: We don't just sell remote work; we live it. Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere.
* Hyper\-Growth: Be part of a company that is consistently recognized for its rapid expansion and innovation.
* Inclusion Matters: We are committed to building a diverse team. We value different perspectives and empower every individual to bring their authentic self to work.

title: Senior Manager, DSP Partnerships, EMEA
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Manager, DSP Partnerships, EMEA to join our team in Madrid or in London and play a key role in shaping the future of neuro\-contextual advertising at a global scale.

#### **Who We Are**


Seedtag is the leading Neuro\-Contextual Advertising Company.  

We are redefining how advertising works in a privacy\-first world by moving beyond keywords and cookies, towards understanding human emotion, intent, and context.


Powered by advanced AI and neuroscience, our proprietary technology, Liz, delivers a deep, human\-like understanding of content and attention. This enables brands to connect with audiences at the right moment, in the right mindset, with ads that are relevant, engaging, and respectful of the user experience.


Founded in 2014 by two ex\-Googlers, Seedtag has grown into a global company with 500\+ Seedtaggers across 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and expanding rapidly across the open web and Connected TV.


We’re not just building technology, we’re rewriting the rules of advertising.

#### **The Role**


Seedtag is the leader in neuro\-contextual advertising. We help brands reach people through the content they care about, without relying on cookies. Our exchange and our curation platform, NeuroX, give buyers premium European inventory and contextual audiences that DSPs can activate at scale.


We are hiring a Director, DSP Partnerships, EMEA to grow our revenue with DSPs across the region. This is a seller role as much as a partnership role. You will own relationships with local EMEA DSPs and with the EMEA teams of global DSPs. Your job is to make Seedtag the go\-to partner for contextual audiences and curated packages in every market you cover.


You will focus on three goals:

* Upsell Seedtag audiences and curated packages to DSP partners and their buyers.
* Maximize local opportunities with the EMEA teams of global DSPs, market by market.
* Onboard new local players and drive new business with curation and neuro\-contextual segments.

#### **Your Challenge**


As Senior Manager, DSP Partnerships, EMEA, you will:


1\. Upsell audiences and packages

* Sell Seedtag's neuro\-contextual audiences and NeuroX curated packages to DSP partners and their agency and brand buyers.
* Grow PMP and curated deal volume with every partner you own.
* Build a clear value story for each DSP: why Seedtag, which packages, and what results buyers can expect.
* Find upsell opportunities in data, formats (display, video, CTV) and new markets.


2\. Maximize local opportunities with global DSPs

* Own the EMEA teams of global DSPs, such as The Trade Desk, Google DV360, Amazon DSP, Yahoo DSP, StackAdapt, RTB House, Criteo and Adform.
* Build relationships with their local sales, account and partnership leads in each key market (UK, France, DACH, Spain, Italy, Benelux, Nordics).
* Use their local buyer relationships to create joint go\-to\-market plans, co\-selling and deal activation.
* Write a strategic account plan for each partner. Map their organization, their priorities and Seedtag's fit. Track share of wallet and grow it.


3\. Drive new business and onboard local players

* Explain and bring to market Seedtag's curation capabilities through NeuroX. Help DSPs and their buyers understand how curated deals work and why they perform.
* Expand the use of our neuro\-contextual segments across each DSP's organization, from partnership teams to local sellers and buyers.
* Identify, pitch and sign regional and local DSPs that are not yet connected to Seedtag.
* Negotiate commercial terms and lead each new partnership from contract to first spend.
* Work with Solutions, Ad Ops and Product to deliver fast, clean integrations (OpenRTB, deal IDs, curation).
* Ramp new partners with launch plans, training and regular business reviews.


Across all three

* Own a revenue target for your EMEA DSP portfolio and exceed it through active selling, partnership management, product and feature implementation, and demand facilitation. Report on it with clear forecasts.
* Build playbooks with the sellers at each DSP. Help them discover Seedtag's full suite of products and audiences, and know when to pitch them to their buyers.
* Engage stakeholders at every level, from day\-to\-day contacts to the C\-suite, both at partners and inside Seedtag.
* Work cross\-functionally with Technical Operations, Sales, Account Management, Product, Engineering, BI and Legal to deliver results.
* Represent Seedtag at executive meetings and industry events across EMEA.
* Bring DSP feedback into the product roadmap.

#### **What You’ll Need to Succeed**

* 8–10\+ years in programmatic advertising, ideally at a DSP, SSP or exchange, in partnership, business development or sales roles.
* A seller's mindset. You have a track record of hitting revenue targets and closing commercial deals.
* A strong, active network with DSPs in EMEA, both local players and the EMEA teams of global platforms.
* Deep knowledge of DSP integrations, bid mechanics, deal types (PMP, PG, curated deals) and key metrics.
* Experience selling audiences, data or curated packages to the buy side.
* Proven ability to build relationships at multiple levels of an organization, from daily contacts to the C\-suite, both internally and at partners. Strong negotiation and executive communication skills.
* Comfort working across teams and countries in a fast\-moving company.
* Fluent English. Multiple European languages strongly preferred (e.g. Spanish, French, German, Italian).


It would be a plus

* Experience with contextual targeting, cookieless solutions or curation platforms.
* Relationships with agency trading desks and holding companies in EMEA.
* Knowledge of CTV and video buying in Europe.
* Experience launching new partners from zero to first spend.

#### **Why Join Seedtag?**


This is a defining moment to join Seedtag, a company that combines scale, ambition, and soul.


Growth \& Opportunity: Accelerated, hands\-on development with real ownership, global projects, and internal mobility.


Flexibility: We trust you to balance work and life with flexible schedules and a hybrid model; work from home, the office, or wherever you do your best work.


Learning \& Development: Access to online learning, continuous training, and optional English or Spanish group classes.


Culture that Cares: Well\-being is part of how we work, supported by initiatives like SeedDay, Digital Disconnection, and team\-building moments.


Connection \& Fun: Global events, offsites, celebrations, and a strong sense of belonging across all Seedtag locations.

#### **Ready to Join the Seedtag Universe?**


If you’re looking for a place where technology has soul, where ideas turn into impact, and where people truly come first, welcome to Seedtag.


At Seedtag, we foster an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome diverse perspectives, as they fuel our innovation and growth. If you require any accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know. We’re committed to ensuring a positive and accessible experience.


Send us your CV and let’s build the future of advertising together.

title: Podcast Producer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for an organized, creative and hands\-on **Podcast** **Producer** to lead the end\-to\-end production and delivery of Alea’s two podcasts.


The Podcast Producer will be responsible for the complete operational process, from initial planning and pre\-production through recording, post\-production, approval and final publication. The role will ensure that every episode is produced on time, meets Alea’s quality standards and supports the company’s communications and brand objectives.


Working closely with the **Head of PR \& Communications**, the **Podcast** **Producer** will help define the strategy, positioning, editorial direction and distribution approach for both podcasts. This person will then translate that strategy into a structured production plan and manage its day\-to\-day execution.


This role is ideal for someone who combines editorial judgement, project management and technical production skills and who is comfortable coordinating guests, managing recordings, reviewing edits and overseeing publication across multiple platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\.** **Podcast** **Strategy and Editorial Planning**

* Define the strategy, positioning, objectives and target audience for both podcasts in collaboration with the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Contribute ideas for themes, episode topics, formats, guests and editorial series.
* Develop and manage an editorial calendar and release schedule for both podcasts.
* Ensure podcast topics and guests are aligned with Alea’s brand positioning, communications priorities and business objectives.
* Research relevant industry topics, trends and conversations to identify new editorial opportunities.
* Prepare episode concepts and proposals for review and approval by the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Regularly review the performance and direction of both podcasts and recommend strategic improvements.

### **2\. Pre\-production**

* Manage the complete pre\-production process for every episode.
* Research topics, guests and relevant background information.
* Identify and coordinate potential guests in collaboration with the Head of PR \& Communications and other stakeholders.
* Manage guest invitations, confirmations, calendars and all pre\-recording communications.
* Prepare episode briefs, scripts, interview structures, talking points and run\-of\-show documents.
* Organize recording schedules, locations and required resources.
* Coordinate studios, external production partners or technical suppliers when needed.
* Confirm that recording equipment, software, lighting, sound and other technical requirements are ready before each session.
* Brief hosts, guests and relevant stakeholders before recording.
* Ensure all necessary permissions, consent forms and content approvals are obtained.

### **3\. Recording and Live Production**

* Lead and coordinate each recording session, ensuring the process runs smoothly from start to finish.
* Set up or supervise cameras, microphones, lighting and recording software.
* Perform technical checks before every recording.
* Direct hosts and guests during the session when required.
* Monitor audio and video quality throughout the recording.
* Follow the agreed episode structure while allowing space for natural and engaging conversations.
* Identify strong moments, quotes and potential promotional clips during the recording.
* Resolve operational or technical issues quickly and efficiently.
* Ensure all recorded material is correctly saved, backed up and organized after each session.

### **4\. Post\-production and Quality Control**

* Manage the full post\-production process for every episode.
* Edit or coordinate the editing of audio and video content.
* Review all edits and provide clear feedback to internal or external editors.
* Ensure the final episode has strong pacing, narrative flow and consistent audio and video quality.
* Coordinate the addition of intros, outros, music, graphics, subtitles and other branded elements.
* Identify and prepare the strongest moments for trailers, teasers and promotional clips.
* Ensure every episode follows Alea’s brand guidelines and editorial standards.
* Manage the internal review and approval process with the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Complete a final quality check before publication, including audio, video, titles, descriptions, links, subtitles and visual assets.
* Maintain an organized archive of raw recordings, project files, final episodes and supporting materials.

### **5\. Publication and Distribution**

* Manage the publication of each episode across the relevant podcast and video platforms.
* Upload and publish episodes on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music, Audible, YouTube and any other selected distribution channels.
* Prepare accurate and engaging episode titles, descriptions, show notes, timestamps and supporting copy.
* Coordinate thumbnails, cover images and other visual assets with the Design team.
* Ensure episodes are correctly categorized, tagged and optimized for discoverability.
* Coordinate publication dates and promotional activity with the Head of PR \& Communications and Social Media \& Content Manager.
* Verify that every episode is published correctly and is accessible across all relevant platforms.
* Update or correct published content when necessary.
* Ensure podcast information and episodes are properly featured on alea.com when relevant.

### **6\. Promotional Content Coordination**

* Identify the strongest quotes, insights and moments from each episode for promotional use.
* Create or coordinate trailers, teasers, audiograms and short\-form video clips.
* Provide the Social Media \& Content Manager with the materials, context and key messages needed to promote each episode.
* Collaborate on the preparation of an episode\-specific promotional plan.
* Ensure all promotional assets are delivered before the agreed publication date.
* Coordinate with the Design team on thumbnails, templates, graphics and other branded materials.
* Support the repurposing of podcast episodes into articles, social media posts and other communication formats.

### **7\. Production and Stakeholder Management**

* Own and maintain the production workflow for both podcasts.
* Coordinate hosts, guests, internal teams, studios and external suppliers.
* Create clear timelines and ensure all milestones and publication deadlines are met.
* Keep the Head of PR \& Communications informed about progress, risks, delays and required decisions.
* Manage feedback and approvals efficiently to avoid production bottlenecks.
* Maintain production documentation, episode trackers, guest information and content archives.
* Monitor external production costs and resources when applicable.
* Identify opportunities to make the production process more efficient, scalable and consistent.

### **8\. Performance Analysis and Optimization**

* Track podcast performance across the relevant distribution and video platforms.
* Monitor metrics such as downloads, plays, views, watch time, audience retention, completion rate and subscriber growth.
* Analyse performance by podcast, episode, topic, guest and content format.
* Prepare regular performance reports with key findings and actionable recommendations.
* Report results and insights to the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Use audience and performance data to improve topics, formats, episode duration, production and distribution.
* Monitor podcast trends, competitors and industry benchmarks to identify opportunities for growth.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At least **2–3 years of experience** in podcast, audio, video, broadcast or digital content production.
* Demonstrable experience managing the complete podcast production process, from pre\-production to publication.
* Experience recording and editing professional audio and video content.
* Hands\-on knowledge of microphones, cameras, lighting, recording software and editing tools.
* Experience with podcast hosting and distribution platforms, as well as YouTube Studio.
* Strong editorial judgement and storytelling skills.
* Ability to prepare briefs, scripts, interview structures and production documents.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to manage multiple episodes, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Confident working with senior leadership, hosts, guests and external suppliers.
* Proactive, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership of the full production process.
* Full professional proficiency in English.
* Spanish proficiency is considered an advantage.
* Previous experience in B2B, technology, media or iGaming is desirable.

**What We Offer**
=================

* A competitive salary package based on your experience.
* An impressive benefits package, focused on our culture of integral health that includes medical insurance, gym with personal trainer, sauna and hyperbaric chamber, and fresh fruit every day.
* Tax\-advantageous wage benefit: Meal card, transport package and other measures such as childcare allowance.
* Discount on Veg it (vegan meals) to order your lunch at the office.
* Flexible start and finish times.
* Reduced working hours in August.
* 23 holidays plus 3 extra days at disposal
* Hybrid Work Model.
* English classes
* Parking benefit for those who live outside of Barcelona.
* And what we are very proud of, you will join a young, motivated and powerful team with a great team culture. As it’s not all work, we maintain the team spirit with team building events, parties and workshops where you can enjoy our achievements. When you leave in the afternoon, you can join our paddle tennis games near the office.
