title: Senior CRM Lifecycle + Journeys Manager
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**



Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer\-to\-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.



What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross\-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.


**OUR CULTURE**



Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.


* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long\-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade\-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member \- no matter their level \- has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.


If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug\-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**THE ROLE**



The **Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle \+ Journeys** owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in\-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win\-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.



This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.



Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity\-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged\-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.



You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.


**Responsibilities**


* Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026\), DE (October 2026\), and FR (November 2026\): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post\-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win\-back, replenishment, care instructions.
* Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end\-to\-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept\-to\-deployment time within 90 days.
* Partner with the Data team to run the triggered\-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.
* Build channel\-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market.
* Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged\-in routing for non\-consenting users.
* Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN\-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.
* Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity\-resolution accuracy.


**Qualifications**


**Required:**

* 6\+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).
* Hands\-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.
* Hands\-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.
* Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.
* SQL proficient. Can self\-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.
* A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).
* Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.
* Detail\-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt\-in state, suppression rules).
* Strong cross\-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.


**Preferred:**


* Multi\-market lifecycle experience (UK \+ DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app\-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR.

title: Hardware Industrialization Specialist
description:
### **Position**

Being part of LOEWE means learning every day alongside passionate teams in a fast\-paced, ambitious and creative environment.


As **Hardware Industrialization Specialist** , you will drive the end\-to\-end industrialization of new hardware components from design validation through series production, ensuring optimal balance between aesthetic excellence, strict timelines, cost efficiency, and technical reliability.  



### **Job responsibilities**

* Drive time\-to\-production targets and manage launch schedules
* Review and validate aesthetics with Design in alignment with industrialization constraints
* Manage testing processes (request, follow\-up, and validation) alongside suppliers and quality teams
* Conduct price negotiations, capacity analysis, and tooling/mould investments for production
* Optimize manufacturing methods for each launch to drive cost improvements
* Oversee pre\-series control, final approvals, master management, and PLM documentation
* Ensure system price updates and manage production risk analysis
* Provide technical expertise for root cause analysis and quality issue resolution
* Define, improve, and deploy technical standards across projects
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and countertyping analysis
* Build and maintain relationships with industry experts, staying abreast of new technologies, laboratories, and manufacturing advancements
### **Profile**

* 3 to 4 years of experience in a similar role managing development and/or purchasing for leather goods accessories, jewelry, or trimmings
* Degree in Industrial Engineering or Materials Engineering
* Strong negotiation and communication skills
* Proficiency in 3D modeling, rendering, and animation is a plus
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel), familiarity with AI tools, and fluency in various ERP systems
* Knowledge of PLM (Centric) software is a plus
* English proficiency (C1 or C2\) is mandatory; French, Chinese, or Italian is a plus
* Flexibility to travel to Europe and Asia
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

The Vice President, Head of EMEA Power and Renewables Research will lead Wood Mackenzie's Power and Renewables Research team for the EMEA region. The role combines team leadership, development of the research roadmap, commercial ownership of the Lens EMEA Power and Renewables offering, senior level industry engagement and collaboration with internal stakeholders (product, sales, marketing, consulting) to drive impact and commercial success.


The candidate will define and deliver the research roadmap for the EMEA Power and Renewables offering, lead the team responsible for shaping Wood Mackenzie's EMEA power and renewables market intelligence, and represent Wood Mackenzie across the region's energy industry through frequent engagement with clients, media and industry stakeholders. They will work closely with colleagues across research, product, sales, marketing and consulting to ensure our market views and product offering remain relevant, differentiated, timely, actionable and commercially successful.


As Wood Mackenzie continues to evolve from a leading research provider into a connected intelligence platform, spanning data, analytics, technology and expert insight, this role will strengthen and extend our leadership in EMEA power and renewables markets.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own the research content strategy for EMEA power and renewables and decide how the offering develops in response to market changes and client demand, while providing predictive and actionable intelligence. Ensure that the EMEA Power and Renewables views feed into Wood Mackenzie’s broader integrated and connected offerings across its portfolio.

* Lead, coach and develop a team of research analysts and senior analysts covering wind, solar, energy storage and power markets across EMEA, building analytical depth, subject matter expertise, and succession plans within the team.

* Hold commercial management responsibility for the EMEA Power and Renewables Lens offering, tracking performance and working with product, sales and marketing to ensure the offering meets its commercial targets.

* Define and deliver the roadmap for EMEA Power and Renewables, working with the product team to prioritise new content, data, and functionality that meet evolving client needs.

* Partner closely with sales, marketing and consulting teams to support renewals, upsell and bespoke client engagements, and to effectively market the team's research and the wider Lens offering.

* Produce and oversee high\-quality, forward\-looking thought leadership, including written research, commentary, and presentations, that anticipate and respond to major developments across wind, solar, storage and power markets.

* Represent Wood Mackenzie through frequent engagement with the industry — media, conferences and client events — building a distinctive and authoritative public profile that reinforces our position as the most trusted and integrated source of EMEA power and renewables intelligence.

* Build and sustain relationships with senior clients and prospects, including industry C\-suite, investment leadership, and government and institutional stakeholders, driving commercial outcomes and deepening Wood Mackenzie's market influence across the region.

* Own headcount planning, hiring and resource allocation for the team, ensuring the right mix of skills and coverage across the region's markets.

**Experience**


You will bring 10\+ years of experience in power and renewables market research, analysis or consulting, potentially gained within a major energy company, utility, developer, or a leading research and analytics firm.


You will have:

* Expertise in EMEA power market fundamentals, complemented by strong working knowledge of wind, solar and energy storage markets.

* Demonstrated experience leading and developing a team of analysts or researchers, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

* Commercial experience managing a subscription, portfolio, research or data product, including ownership of a product roadmap and working cross\-functionally with sales, product and marketing to drive commercial performance.

* Strong written skills and a proven track record of delivering market analysis to inform high\-stakes strategic, investment, or policy decisions.

* Experience representing an organization's views externally — through media commentary, conference speaking, published research, and client presentations. Recognised as a subject matter expert or thought leader.
* Established relationships with senior figures across the EMEA energy sector, including executives, investors, and government or institutional stakeholders.

* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distil complex market dynamics into compelling narratives for senior audiences.

* Familiarity with data\-driven and quantitative approaches to market analysis, and an appetite to work at the frontier of how power and renewables market intelligence is developed.

* Strong problem\-solving skills and AI\-forward thinking

title: Video Producer
description:
**About Frontiers**


At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.


We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open\-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer\-reviewed and quality\-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real\-world impact of science without barriers.


Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission\-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

**About the role**


We're looking for a **Video Producer** to join our Visual Design team and work closely with the Senior Video Producer to expand and accelerate Frontiers' video storytelling. In this role, you'll take ownership of video productions from planning and filming through to post\-production, creating interviews, talking\-head content, b\-roll, and studio shoots for company\-wide communications and campaigns.


As a second videographer, you'll have the opportunity to lead independent shoots while also supporting larger productions led by the Senior Video Producer. You'll combine strong technical video skills with excellent organization, ensuring that shoots run smoothly, footage meets Frontiers' creative and technical standards, and media assets are efficiently managed throughout the production process.


You'll work closely with colleagues across Communications and Visual Design, as well as researchers, authors, employees, external contributors, and production partners. If you enjoy working both behind the camera and behind the scenes, solving problems on the go, and creating high\-quality visual content in a fast\-paced environment, you'll thrive in this role.


You'll also contribute to improving video production workflows by using technology, AI\-powered tools, and consistent production practices to streamline scheduling, media management, transcription, subtitling, and post\-production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate video shoots end\-to\-end, including scheduling interviews, talking\-head sessions, b\-roll, and studio productions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare and distribute call sheets, coordinate shoot logistics, and ensure crews and on\-camera participants have clear information about locations, timings, requirements, and expectations.
* Scout and book filming locations, studios, and meeting spaces, coordinating travel arrangements and equipment transportation for shoots outside Lausanne.
* Prepare, test, organize, and maintain camera, lighting, audio, and studio equipment, ensuring all production kits are ready for each assignment.
* Independently film interviews, talking\-heads, b\-roll, and studio content, operating professional camera, lighting, and audio equipment to a consistently high standard.
* Work as a second camera operator and provide technical support on larger and multi\-camera productions led by the Senior Video Producer.
* Welcome and brief on\-camera participants, helping guests feel comfortable and confident throughout the filming process while ensuring required release forms and consent documentation are completed.
* Ingest, back up, organize, and archive raw footage following established folder structures, file\-naming conventions, and media management practices.
* Support post\-production by cutting and editing footage, applying colour grading and established brand guidelines, creating and using motion graphics, and preparing subtitles and AI\-assisted transcriptions.
* Work with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, and other relevant production tools to support high\-quality video delivery.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external production partners, including freelance crew, studios, equipment suppliers, editors, and post\-production specialists.
* Identify and resolve technical, logistical, and production challenges independently while maintaining quality, schedules, and production standards.
* Contribute to improving video production workflows, playbooks, and best practices, helping the team increase production capacity and deliver content efficiently.

  

**Requirements**  

* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in video production, videography, or a similar role, with experience taking video projects from production planning and filming through to post\-production.

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.


**About the Role**

The Senior Analyst (AM) – Social \& Activation Strategist supports the day\-to\-day delivery of integrated digital and social programmes, primarily for Wella and Galderma. The role combines client coordination, content development and publishing, community management, creator partnerships, social listening and performance reporting.
  

Working closely with the wider Digital team, the successful candidate will help identify cultural, platform and real\-time opportunities that strengthen campaign relevance, responsiveness and effectiveness. This role is suited to someone who is organised, digitally curious and comfortable managing multiple workstreams in a fast\-paced agency environment.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Support day\-to\-day client coordination and delivery across Wella, Galderma and other Digital assignments.
* Help plan, develop, review and publish social content in line with brand, channel and campaign requirements.
* Manage community engagement and support timely, culturally relevant responses to audience conversations.
* Coordinate creator and influencer activity, including research, outreach, briefing, content tracking and reporting.
* Monitor social platforms, cultural trends and emerging conversations to identify real\-time opportunities and potential risks.
* Support social listening, campaign measurement and performance reporting, translating results into clear insights and recommended actions.
* Maintain content calendars, status documents and project timelines, escalating delivery risks when required.
* Collaborate with strategy, creative, account and production colleagues to deliver high\-quality, integrated work.
* Apply strong quality control across copy, assets, publishing and reporting outputs.

Contribute to other assignments and new\-business opportunities as team priorities require.
  

  

**Experience, Skills and Attributes**  

* A minimum of 4–5 years of relevant experience within digital/social media, influencer or creator teams, preferably in an agency environment.
* Native\-level or fully professional Spanish, with strong awareness of local culture, tone and audience behaviour.
* Professional working proficiency in English.
* Strong organisation, attention to detail and the ability to manage several workstreams simultaneously.
* Familiarity with major social platforms, publishing workflows, social listening, creator marketing and performance metrics.
* Collaborative, curious and proactive, with sound judgement, clear communication and a genuine interest in beauty, health, culture and digital trends.

  

This is a fixed\-term role created to maintain continuity and high\-quality delivery across key client accounts during a nine\-month period of leave coverage.
We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Performance Creativities Coordinator
description:
#### **Tu misión**


Convertir la estrategia de testing del Creative Strategist / Head of Growth en un flujo constante y fiable de assets publicados. Es la responsable última de que los assets llegan a tiempo, con las especificaciones correctas y en el volumen necesario para alimentar el calendario de testing semanal: no coordina la producción, la lidera y la entrega. Su misión es que estrategia y ejecución avancen juntas, trabajando estrechamente con el Creative Strategist en prioridades, sourcing, briefing y entrega, garantizando que el canal nunca se queda sin contenido para testear.

#### **Tu perfil**


Dentro de sus responsabilidades, el/la Performance Creativities Coordinator será responsable de

**Ejecución y entrega de assets**

* Traduce las prioridades de testing del Creative Strategist en briefs concretos y ejecutables (concepto × acabado × formato)
* Hace seguimiento del estado de cada asset desde el brief hasta la entrega y alerta de retrasos con antelación suficiente
* Mantiene la biblioteca de assets organizada por canal y formato, con naming convention que permita rastrear rendimiento y reutilizar material
* Garantiza que cada asset cumple las especificaciones técnicas por canal: Meta, TikTok, AmazoN

**UGC y producción con creadores/as*** Busca, briefea y gestiona el pool de creadoras UGC
* Es la propietaria de la cadencia de entrega y los derechos de uso del contenido de creadoras
* Coordina con agencias externas la ejecución y entrega de briefs
* Mantiene un ritmo de entrega semanal constante alineado con el calendario de testing del Creative Strategist

**Relaciones clave*** Creative Strategist / Head of Growth: calendario de testing, prioridades y briefs — es su interlocutor/a principal
* Creadoras UGC y talent: sourcing, briefing y gestión de la relación
* UGC marketplaces: sourcing de nuevas creadoras
* Media Buyer: coordinación de go\-live y publicación de anuncios
* Equipo de diseño (vídeo y estático): dirección de arte y capacidad de producción
* Creative Manager: coordinación de la producción creativa con el equipo de diseño

**KPIS de medición del rol:*** Assets entregados en spec y en plazo
* Volumen de assets producidos por mes, desglosado por formato y canal
* Cumplimiento de la cadencia de entrega semanal
* Velocidad de testing creativo (compartido con Creative Strategist)

 **Perfil orientado y requerimientos:****Experiencia y background:**

* 2\-4 años en producción de contenido, coordinación creativa o UGC en entornos DTC o performance marketing
* Experiencia gestionando creadores/as con capacidad demostrada de obtener resultados positivos en las colaboraciones
* Haber trabajado en producción de alto volumen y alta cadencia, no en proyectos puntuales o hero assets
* Comprensión básica de paid social y qué métricas validan un concepto en Meta, TikTok y Amazon
* Muy valorable: experiencia trabajando codo a codo con un equipo de paid social o growth donde el contenido se mide por resultados
* Muy valorable: experiencia en health, beauty, wellness o alimentación

**Conocimientos clave:**  

* Criterio creativo propio: sabe cuándo una toma no vale, da feedback concreto y pide repetición
* Mentalidad de escala: optimiza para rango y velocidad, sabe cuándo algo es suficientemente bueno para testear
* Comodidad con sistemas estructurados: naming conventions, tracking de assets por concepto y volumen contra objetivo semanal
* Rigor absoluto en claims: ante la duda, se pregunta, no se publica
* Coordinación transversal con equipos que no le reportan, sin perder velocidad de entrega
* Don de gentes para construir relaciones de confianza con creadores/as
* Organización y fiabilidad: el equipo puede contar con ella para que lo prometido llega cuando estaba prometido
* Mejora continua: busca activamente cómo producir más con los mismos recursos sin perder calidad

#### **¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?**

* Unirte a una compañía con propósito real: alimentación saludable e innovación
* Salario acorde con *mercado* según know\-how
* Cultura de colaboración, aprendizaje y confianza
* Posibilidad clara de crecimiento con el proyecto
* Modelo de trabajo híbrido (4p\+1tt)
* Retribución flexible con nuestro partner Cobe*e*
* Descuentos top en todos los productos de Baïa
* Programa Baïa Benefits enfocados en tu bienestar físico y mental (te detallamos más adelante)

#### **¿Quiénes somos?**


En **Baïa Food** tenemos claro que con nuestro trabajo, cada día contribuimos a un gran propósito: **Acompañar a las personas en su camino hacia el bienestar para que puedan disfrutar de una vida más plena**. Pero, ¿Cómo lo hacemos? A través del desarrollo de **suplementos alimenticios innovadores basados en evidencia científica** y buen sabor, **sin azúcares ni edulcorantes.**

title: AI Search Innovation Lead
description:
Hey there!
  

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.



Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting\-edge technology and data\-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  

  

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in \+55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.



Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award\-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?



To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar\-raisers with a hands\-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  

  

Ready to be part of the experience?



Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

**Meet The Team**



At Fever's SEO team, we capture and influence demand when millions search for what to do next. We engineer visibility across the entire discovery ecosystem: traditional search engines, LLMs, local listings, third party integrations and beyond. Our diverse portfolio of ecosystems and operating companies gives us the scale and complexity to master every SEO specialization—from technical infrastructure and content architecture, to AI search optimization, local market dominance, and brand authority building. We operate globally, automating and optimizing processes to drive efficiency at scale.  

  

We combine data, technical excellence, and strategic thinking to drive organic growth revenue. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Operational teams, we shape how users discover experiences across our global platforms.  

  

Join us to redefine how the world finds experiences, together.


**The Role**



At Fever, we're building something exceptional—combining strategy, creativity, and the power of advanced technology to redefine what's possible in organic search. By partnering with world\-class Product, Engineering, Data and Marketing teams, we leverage cutting\-edge tools and data\-driven insights to deliver exceptional performance and measurable impact across major search engines and dynamic digital ecosystems.



As an AI Search Innovation Lead, you will drive the evolution of our brand's authority in the next era of search, focusing entirely on impact over traditional acronyms. You will lead the testing and measurement of how LLMs construct answers, designing the analytical frameworks to track our visibility across major AI models and emerging platforms like MCPs. Collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and PR teams, you will optimize our architecture for seamless AI ingestion and execute strategies to actively shape and accelerate LLM perception.


**What You´ll Do**



Forget about acronyms like SEO, GEO, AEO or AEO, we care about impact. We're seeking an AI Search Innovation Strategist obsessed with digging into how LLMs build their answers and defining how to measure it. You'll be focused on testing new tools, MCPs, and platforms, evolving SEO discipline to maximize our brand's authority in the next era.


* Own the strategic evolution of core SEO practices by integrating methods to secure our brand's authoritative presence across all major LLMs and AI search results.
* Lead testing and measurement: Design and execute testing to decipher how established SEO signals influence LLM citations and generative presence.
* Design and maintain the analytical framework to measure AI visibility performance. Proactively integrate new data sources, external and internal, and provide methodologies to ensure accurate reporting.
* Collaborate intensively with Product and Engineering to ensure our data schema, site architecture, and API feeds are optimally engineered for seamless ingestion and prioritization by AI models.
* Continuously evaluate all new LLM releases, AI models, and emerging platforms (including MCPs), translating industry developments into actionable testing strategies.
* Design and execute PR and community conversation strategies to accelerate and measure LLM perception.


**Who You Are**


* You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics or Big Data (STEM degree)
* You bring to the table 6\-9 years of relevant experience on SEO, demonstrating ownership, attention to detail, and a proactive, self\-motivated approach to problem solving
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills as well as a strong bias towards data\-based decision
* Your exceptional written and verbal communication skills enable you to excel in cross\-functional collaboration and effectively convey complex concepts to diverse audiences with varying backgrounds
* Working knowledge in Python, JavaScript, or other programming languages is required and familiarity with SQL is a plus
* Proficiency in both written and spoken English is a must, while knowledge of additional languages is a valuable asset.


**Why You´ll Love It Here**


* Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences \+ free Candlelight voucher.
* Flexible remuneration with Cobee: meals, transport, training, and nursery support (tax\-exempt).
* Payflow: option to access part of your salary in advance.
* Taxdown: help optimizing and filing your taxes. You can also pay for an upgrade to manage your Beckham Law application, along with other tax\-related procedures.
* Private health \& dental insurance with Cigna: 100% covered by Fever. You can also add your family members via flexible remuneration.
* Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.
* Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
* Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Madrid office location.
* Snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit are always available at the office.
* Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.


\#LI\-Hybrid

  

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!



If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog \| Tech.Eu \|TechCrunch



Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!



If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

title: AI Project Manager
description:
At Sanoma Learning, we all share a deep\-rooted passion for education and are committed to support teachers to help all students to reach their potential, so they can be at their best in class. We are proud of the impact we make together across Europe, local as well as international. As our teams and the scope of our impact grows, so do the opportunities for us to learn from each other – across country borders and areas of expertise. With over 3\.000 colleagues, we work on seamlessly integrated print, digital and blended learning solutions to help teachers and schools develop the talents of every child. Our people are passionate and committed and always willing to go the extra mile for students, teachers, schools, our shareholders and each other.


We believe that Data and AI can uncover multiple opportunities for education, including both internal efficiencies and new product opportunities; currently AI is a priority theme for Sanoma Learning.  



**AI Project Manager**

The AI Project Manager is part of the AI Enablement team – the small central team that makes AI work at Sanoma Learning possible: setting direction, building the foundations, and connecting the many parties involved. The team works as a flexible unit: members take ownership of the initiatives that matter most at a given moment, and capacity is redirected as priorities shift.  



Within that team, this role carries a clear centre of gravity: it is the connection point between AI at Sanoma Learning and the outside world, and between the AI team and the functions that own communication and strategy. The role does not replace those functions. It makes sure they have the AI substance, the right experts and the right coordination to do their work well – and it turns what the AI teams do into something that colleagues, customers, partners and the wider education community can understand and engage with.  



Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Data and AI, the AI Project Manager works across operating companies and central functions – Communications, Strategy, M\&A, Legal and the product and experimentation teams – and represents the AI agenda in those forums. This role also assumes matrix reporting into the Competence Lead of Project Management.  



**Key Responsibilities**

**AI communication – internal and external**

Acting as the AI team’s counterpart to the Communications function: bringing the content, the context and the experts, and coordinating the AI side of delivery.


* **Own the editorial cycle of the AI update newsletter** – collect input from AI initiatives and opcos, shape the story, manage the calendar and the review loop with Communications.
* **Run the AI webinar and event series** – programme, speakers, preparation of presenters, logistics with the relevant functions, and follow\-up.
* **Curate and maintain the AI Hub** – keep it current and usable, agree the content structure with contributing teams, and chase the contributions that make it worth visiting.
* **Coordinate AI content for the external website and corporate channels** – gather and quality\-assure input from the AI teams, propose what should be told publicly, and work with Communications, who own publication.
* **Sync a shared communication calendar for AI with communications** – so that announcements, launches, webinars and external moments are sequenced rather than colliding.

**Thought leadership and external presence**

Working with the Strategy function, which owns Sanoma Learning’s thought leadership agenda, to ensure AI is represented with credible substance.


* **Build and manage a pipeline of external speaking opportunities** – identify the conferences and forums worth being at, manage submissions and deadlines, and match the right internal speaker to each.
* **Prepare speakers and material** – coordinate narrative, evidence and rehearsal so that colleagues representing Sanoma Learning externally are well equipped.
* **Drive the production of white papers and publications on AI in education** – coordinate authors, source the evidence from our own initiatives, and run the process to publication with Strategy and Communications.
* **Manage relationships with research institutions and academic partners** – keep the contacts warm, track joint work, and identify where research collaboration strengthens our position.
* **Track the external conversation on AI in education** – what peers, policymakers and researchers are saying – and feed that back into the AI agenda.

**AI partnership and M\&A funnel**

Owning the front end of the AI partnership pipeline, feeding the teams that own the decisions and the transactions.


* **Build and maintain the funnel of AI\-related partnership and acquisition opportunities** – sourcing, structured overview, status and next steps.
* **Run first\-pass screening of candidates** – what they do, how it relates to our AI direction, what a fit would look like – and prepare the material that lets leadership decide what to pursue.
* **Organise the AI\-side assessment** – pull in the technical, product, privacy and compliance expertise needed to evaluate an opportunity properly, and consolidate the view.
* **Coordinate with Strategy and M\&A** , and with the business owners who would take on the partnership.
* **Maintain the relationship layer with active AI partners and vendors** – cadence, follow\-up and internal visibility of what each partnership is delivering.

**Leading AI initiatives and projects**

As a member of a small, flexible team, taking direct ownership of initiatives where capacity and momentum are needed.


* **Lead assigned AI initiatives and projects end to end** – scope, plan, stakeholders, delivery and closure – across the full breadth of the AI agenda.
* **Step into initiatives that need to move** – taking over, unblocking or accelerating work as priorities shift, including topics outside the communication and partnership scope.
* **Bring structure to ambiguous work** – turn broad intentions into a plan with owners, milestones and a decision path.
* **Prepare and facilitate the forums that move decisions forward** – working sessions, steering updates and executive material.
* **Represent the AI Enablement team in cross\-functional programmes** where AI is one of several contributing tracks.

**How this role works with others**

Communication and thought leadership are owned by dedicated functions at Sanoma Learning, and this role does not duplicate them. Its value lies in being the AI team’s connection into those functions: supplying substance and expertise, coordinating the AI\-side contributors, keeping the AI agenda sequenced and visible, and making sure opportunities are not lost because no one on the AI side was joining the dots. The success measure is that Communications and Strategy are consistently well served by AI – not that AI does their work.  



  

**A successful candidate will have the following:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
* Project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) are a strong advantage.

Additional coursework or certification in AI/ML, communications, or digital transformation is a plus.  

* 

**Experience**

* 4\+ years of professional experience in project, programme or initiative management in a digital, technology or innovation context, with at least 2 years connected to AI, data or digital transformation topics.
* Demonstrated experience in corporate or B2B communication – for example newsletters, webinars, content platforms, website content or campaign coordination – working with or within a communications function.
* Experience preparing executive\-level and external\-facing material, and supporting senior colleagues in representing the organisation publicly.
* Exposure to partnership management, vendor evaluation, corporate development or M\&A support activities.
* Experience working across multiple stakeholders and business units, preferably in multi\-country or federated environments.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and the current AI landscape, sufficient to translate technical work into language a business or public audience understands.
* Hands\-on experience with collaboration and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, SharePoint) and with content or intranet platforms.

Experience in education, publishing or EdTech, or with research institutions, is a plus.  

* 

**Skills**

* Excellent written communication in English – able to turn technical and strategic material into clear, engaging content for different audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management, comfortable working as a connector between a specialist team and central functions without owning either side.
* Solid project management skills, able to run several parallel tracks with clarity on ownership, deadlines and status.
* Sound understanding of AI and data concepts, and the curiosity to keep that understanding current.
* Ability to structure ambiguous problems, facilitate alignment and drive decisions across teams.
* Strong sense for what is worth telling externally, and the judgement to know what is not.
* Comfortable with documentation, editorial process and governance that keep recurring communication running reliably.

Collaborative and proactive mindset, with an ability to connect the dots across organisational silos.  

* 

**Personal Attributes**

* Proactive and positive “can\-do” attitude, demonstrating initiative and resilience.
* Comfortable operating without formal authority, building influence through reliability and usefulness to others.
* Strong organisational skills, adept at managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Flexible and pragmatic – willing to pick up what the team needs at a given moment.
* Data\-driven decision\-making approach.
* Self\-motivated, consistently seeking opportunities for improvement and innovation.

Passionate about the opportunities in the Data and AI space, and about education.  

* 

**About Sanoma Learning**

  

How do you prepare students for the world, engage their curiosity and inspire them to grow? That is the main question of teachers all around the world. At Sanoma Learning, it has always been our mission to help to find and develop best\-in\-class answers to this question. If you join us, it means that you embark on an exciting journey to help shape the future of learning for primary, secondary and vocational education. We believe that your journey is our success as a company.
  

  

Sanoma Learning is a leading K12 European learning company, operating in 12 countries. Our learning products and services enable and support teachers and schools to develop the talents of every child to reach their potential. By offering printed and digital learning content, as well as digital learning and teaching platforms for primary, secondary and vocational education, we want to grow our positive impact on learning across Europe. With over 3000 employees, we help shape the future of education for 25\+ million of students.
  

  

So, are you ready to start your journey to help shape the future of learning and help teachers to support all students to reach their potential?
  

  

*Sanoma Learning is an equal opportunity employer; we are committed to inclusion and diversity, ensure equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics.*

As the HVAC Maintenance Technician in Diego Garcia, Serco\-NA, in conjunction with the United States Space Force (USSF) are responsible for tracking all man\-made objects in orbit. This mission is vital to keeping existing satellites safe and to provide critical information to organizations launching new satellites in the future. One of the assets USSF uses to accomplish this mission is the Ground\-Based Electro\-Optical Deep Space Surveillance (GEODSS) System.


This optical sensor is employed at three (3\) different locations around the world (White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico; Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory; and Maui, Hawaii) and helps track the objects in deep space orbit (altitude of 10,000 to 45,000 km).


Come join the team that provides this service to United States. You will help operate and maintain three (3\), one\-meter telescopes equipped with highly sensitive digital cameras. You’ll respond to Government tasking to obtain metric observations of specific objects daily and help maintain the sensors, support equipment, and the facility that houses it at Detachment 2, Naval Support Facility in Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory (BIOT).

* Competitive salaries,

* Must be able to lift and carry up to 30 pounds.

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:

title: Tech & Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
**Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?**

At **Aleph**, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130\+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long\-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast\-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward\-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.  

We're looking for a proactive, resourceful, and AI\-forward **Tech \& Marketing Operations Specialist** to manage our technology projects, keep our learning platforms running seamlessly, and power the marketing engine that brings students to them



This role suits someone with a broad technical fluency who thrives on coordination, troubleshooting, and hands\-on building. You don't need to be a professional developer, but you do need to be comfortable using tech tools to design, prototype, and ship real solutions.



The position will be based at the Madrid office with a hybrid work model.

  


### **What You’ll Do**


**Platform \& Systems Management**
----------------------------------


* **Tech project management:** Manage technology\-related projects end to end — defining requirements, building timelines, tracking progress, and identifying improvements that serve broader project goals.
* **LMS management (WordPress \& LearnDash):** Own the day\-to\-day health of our WordPress\-based LMS and LearnDash plugin — user administration, course administration, email flows, bulk imports, new features, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* **CRM \& Marketing Automation (Salesforce \& Salesforce Marketing Cloud):** Act as first point of contact for Salesforce and SFMC — build and test journeys, landing pages, and lead magnets; investigate and resolve issues the Operations team can't solve; escalate and follow up when needed.
* **System integration:** Serve as the architect making sure LMS, CRM, Marketing Cloud, and Power BI talk to each other correctly — designing and implementing the technical architecture for data flows between platforms, including low\-code integrations.
* **Data integrity \& reporting:** Review data integrity across LearnDash, Salesforce, and Power BI; execute queries and build reports/extracts for non\-technical stakeholders; handle large\-scale data reviews (including million\-row datasets) when needed.
* **Website support:** Provide general technical support for the website and coordinate with relevant resources to resolve issues.
* **Compliance \& security:** Help bring the LMS environment up to the organization's IT and security standards, acting as liaison between the Education team, developers/cloud providers, and Security/Legal/IT.

**Marketing Operations \& Growth**
----------------------------------


* **Campaign execution:** Build, test, and launch email and lifecycle campaigns in Salesforce Marketing Cloud — segmentation, audience building, A/B tests, send scheduling, and deliverability hygiene.
* **Landing pages \& lead capture:** Build and ship landing pages and forms based on designs provided by the internal design team; ensure correct lead routing into Salesforce, field mapping, deduplication, and follow\-up automation.
* **Tracking \& attribution:** Own the measurement layer — GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion pixels, UTM taxonomy and enforcement — so that every campaign, source, and channel is measurable end to end.
* **Lifecycle \& retention automation:** Design automated flows across the student lifecycle (onboarding, course progress nudges, re\-engagement, certification, upsell) connecting LMS events to CRM and Marketing Cloud triggers.
* **Martech stack \& compliance:** Own the marketing technology stack and its integrations; keep consent management, cookie compliance, and data handling aligned with privacy requirements and company policy.
* **AI for marketing:** Apply the same builder mindset to marketing — AI\-assisted copy and creative variants, campaign localization at scale, automated performance summaries, and audience insight tooling.

**Technical Bridge \& Coordination**
------------------------------------


* **Stakeholder liaison:** Serve as a primary point of contact between internal stakeholders (especially the development team) and business operations, translating business needs into functional technical specifications.
* **Specification writing \& QA:** Write clear technical specs, replicate scenarios, and fully test in QA and production before rollout.
* **Documentation:** Keep the operations manual and technical documentation current and useful for the team.
* **Cross\-functional project leadership:** Lead multi\-month initiatives (e.g., new catalog builds, platform redesigns, global/language expansions, migrations) from scoping through to launch — defining KPIs, coordinating between design/development/vendors, and testing at every step.

**AI Development \& Innovation**
--------------------------------


* **AI builder mindset:** Go beyond being “AI\-savvy” — actively explore, prototype, and build AI\-powered solutions that improve how the team works and how students learn (e.g., translation tools, automation of repetitive data tasks, AI\-assisted reporting).
* **Tool development:** Design and build practical AI tools and workflows (e.g., custom Gemini/Claude “gems”/assistants, scripts, or low\-code automations) to solve real operational bottlenecks — not just use off\-the\-shelf AI features.
* **Exploration \& evaluation:** Stay current on emerging AI tools and platforms relevant to EdTech operations, and proactively propose where they could create value (efficiency, personalization, translation, content scaling, etc.).
* **AI project ownership:** Take end\-to\-end ownership of AI\-driven initiatives — from investigating alternatives and setting up integrations, to testing and rolling out to production (as previously done with AI\-powered course translation tooling).
* **Responsible use:** Use AI tools in a way that's compliant with company confidentiality and data\-security standards, and only with company\-approved systems.
### **What You Need For This Role**


* You have a solid, broad understanding of technology and digital platforms, and you're comfortable getting hands\-on rather than just directing others.
* You have 5\+ years of experience managing Education and Marketing tech projects.
* You are genuinely curious about AI and see it as a tool to build with, not just a topic to discuss — you've built something with AI before (a workflow, an automation, an integration, a tool).
* You bring project management skills with a track record of leading initiatives from scope to delivery.
* You're a strong communicator who moves comfortably between technical and non\-technical audiences.
* You're a proactive problem\-solver, able to identify needs and find the right solutions, people, and tools without waiting to be asked.
* You understand marketing funnels and growth metrics (CPL, CAC, conversion rate, LTV) and can translate them into technical requirements.
* Hands\-on experience with marketing automation and campaign tooling (Salesforce Marketing Cloud strongly preferred) is highly valued.
* Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking setups is a strong plus.
* You are comfortable owning both the plumbing and the outcome — not just that the campaign sends, but that it performs.
* Experience with WordPress and/or LMS platforms (ideally LearnDash) is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce/Salesforce Marketing Cloud preferred) and data/BI tools (Power BI) is highly valued.
* You're highly organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple concurrent projects.
* You're a self\-starter, comfortable working independently.
### **What Will Make Us Really Love You**


* You bring a track record of success in a similar role, with hands\-on experience.
* You’re not afraid to challenge the status quo and bring fresh, out\-of\-the\-box ideas to the table.
* You anticipate challenges before they arise and take initiative to find effective solutions.
* You have an eye for detail.
* You thrive on teamwork but also bring a driven, goal\-oriented spirit.
* You’re genuinely enthusiastic about advertising, ad\-tech, and staying ahead of industry trends.
* You have the ability to engage and communicate with internal and external stakeholders in a positive and approachable way.
### **What You’ll Love About Us**


* We care about your individuality by giving you freedom to grow and create within the company, regardless of your position
* Learn from the best: Our state of the art workshops guarantee the latest insights into digital advertising
* Be part of a company with a truly global footprint, working with leading brands, platforms, and publishers across 90\+ markets.
* We foster a dynamic environment where creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas are encouraged and celebrated.
* Join a diverse, multicultural team that values and embraces different perspectives, experiences, and talents.
* At Aleph, your work directly contributes to connecting brands and consumers in meaningful ways, shaping the future of digital advertising.
In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we are committed to fair and open compensation practices. For this role, the minimum gross annual base salary is EUR 40,000\. In addition to base salary, this role includes a variable component, paid annually. The final offer will reflect your experience, skills, and the scope of the role. **Why Join Us?**

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever\-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

30/10/2026

Hybrid

Europe, Spain, Madrid

Identifying, developing, and scaling AI use cases that deliver tangible business value.

Educational background in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Digital Innovation, or a related field.
  
Strong experience with process optimization, automation, and transformation initiatives.

Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

This role is more than a technology position. It is about building capabilities that will help PBS and ultimately KK Group scale, innovate, and support future growth.

Automate manual processes and achieve 20\-30% reductions in cycle time and cost\-to\-serve across core PBS services.
  
Prepare processes for successful HRIS implementation and future platform transitions.
  
Increase AI adoption and engagement across the PBS AI community.
  
Enable organizational growth without proportional increases in headcount.

We offer

Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office\-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Further information

title: Science Operations Scientist
description:
**Description**
---------------


Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.
  

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, space consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, flight test services, satellite propulsion systems, and much more.
  

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.
  

Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help earth benefit from space?
  

If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact. We are looking for a dedicated professional who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.
**Requirements**
----------------


**Specific qualification requirements**  

* A **PhD** in **Planetary Science** or a related discipline (e.g., Astronomy, Physics).
* Active **researcher** in **planetary science**.
* Familiarity with the **science community** and expertise in a field relevant for the mission(s).
* Connected and with **good reputation** in the planetary **science community**, with which s/he will have to interact regularly.
* Experience in **coordinating** internal/external **stakeholders** on **scientific projects**.
* Experience in **science operations** for **planetary missions** or expertise in **s****pace instrumentation**.
* Good **planning** and **organisation** **skills**, team spirit and ability to work in an **international environment**.
* Proficiency with at least one **scripting** or **programming language** (e.g., Python).
* Be fluent in spoken and written **English**.
* Good **communication** skills.
* Good **team working** skills.

  

**Legal and Security Requirements**
  

* All applicants must be legally allowed to work in Spain without the need to obtain a work visa. Only European Union (EU), European Economic Area (EEA) and SWISS citizens can be employed by SSC Space in Spain.
* Applicants are required to provide a copy of their passport and degree certificate. SSC Space will validate the Degree with the issuing University.
* In line with ESA’s security requirements, prior to issuing a letter of employment the applicant shall provide to SSC Space a recent official document declaring that they are of good conduct from the country where currently resident, and SSC Space will validate your employment history.
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Overview**
  

As Science Operations Scientist you will be assigned to one or two ESA Planetary missions. We currently support the JUICE, BepiColombo, ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter, EnVision, Mars Express, Hera, and M\-Matisse missions. You will join the SSC Space Service team supporting the Science Operation Centres (SOC) which are responsible for the Science Operations of the Missions.
  

  

**Specific Service Tasks**  

As part of the service, the following main tasks will have to be carried out:
  

* Support to strategic science planning.
* Support to long term science planning.
* Definition and maintenance of instruments observations.
* Scientific and operational monitoring of science operation scenarios.
* Quick\-look analysis. Definition of use cases and testing.
* Coverage analysis of science observations.
* Specification of requirements, design, development, testing, validation of any scripts and software required to support each task.

You will be the SOC contact point for several instrument teams in all operational matters, making sure that the instrument science planning, calibration, and quick\-look requirements are properly formulated and understood.
  

In addition, you will contribute to the development of the Science Operations System by specifying requirements and developing prototypes.
**Benefits**
------------


* All employees receive good remuneration in line with function and experience.
* When autonomous then teleworking can often be utilised.
* You will be registered for both social security and tax in Spain.
* There are 12 public holidays and an additional 30 annual days holiday.
* In addition to public health services, SSC Space provides private medical insurance in Spain (the inclusion into the private health insurance policy is at the discretion of the insurance provider).
* Training to improve efficiency and provide strength for future career are of course included.

  

**To be considered for this Position**
  

Prior to **2026\-10\-31**, please apply via our Job Application form.
  

If not directly interested, feel free to share this Job Vacancy with your friends!
  

  

**Outro**
  

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.
  

With local presence on all continents and about 750 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.
  

We help Earth benefit from space. Learn more at sscspace.com

The Lead, Product Management, ELL Institutional Courseware owns Pearson’s global portfolio of English language learning materials for schools, higher education and adult education. This is an opportunity to shape the future of a major global education portfolio. title: X-ray/TEM Postdoctoral Researcher
description:
**X\-ray/TEM Postdoctoral Researcher**
======================================


Reference
2026\-IMPRESS\-1
Deadline
15/11/2026
Division
Experiments
#### **Institution**


ALBA is the Spanish synchrotron light source, a large research infrastructure operating thirteen beamlines, complementary facilities, and an Electron Microscopy Center, this last in partnership with other institutions. Currently constructing multiple more beamlines, expanding the Electron Microscopy Center, and integrating advanced data analytics, it sums up a wide range of infrastructures geared toward finding solutions to societal challenges.


Located in Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain), it is funded by the Spanish Government (Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación) and the Catalan Government (Generalitat de Catalunya, Departament de Recerca i Universitats). The synchrotron light produced by 3 GeV electrons is used by thousands of researchers to analyse and understand the properties and functionality of matter, spanning a wide variety of fields, such as catalytic research, health, energy production/storage, environmental research, communication technologies, or cultural heritage.


Our highly motivated staff works in a multidisciplinary work environment with an atmosphere formed by lived diversity, inclusion and respect for our colleagues. One of the goals of our gender equality plan is to reach parity within the Consortium’s different divisions and offices, and several actions have been taken to encourage applications from women mostly in scientific, engineer and technical job positions.


Located close to Barcelona in a natural park and well connected by car and public transportation, with excellent connectivity to the world and an employer who understands the importance of life\-work balance.


Facing an upgrade to ALBA II, a 4th generation facility, which will increase dramatically brightness and coherent flux, ALBA is in a phase of growth and dynamics. Being a part of the ALBA team will promote your career and will give you the opportunities to explore new territories.


For more information, you can take a look on our history watching this video:


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=gHMqiH4qBAo


#### **Tasks**


This postdoctoral position is dedicated to scientific and technical methods for correlative operando X\-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) and (Scanning) Transmission Electron Microscopy (S)TEM within the frame of the IMPRESS project (Interoperable electron Microscopy Platform for advanced RESearch and Services), funded by HORIZON\-INFRA\-2022\-TECH\-01\-01\.


The IMPRESS project aims to develop an interoperable platform based on a modular and standardized cartridge concept. The cartridges are designed to be inserted into TEM specimen and aperture holders, as well as other instruments for preparation and characterization, including surface science tools, transport measurements, microfocus X\-ray tomography instruments, and synchrotrons. Within IMPRESS, ALBA is involved in the development of a MEMS\-based micro\-reactor for correlative photocatalytic experiments in TEM and synchrotron beamlines for CO2 reduction reaction and generation of high value products.


The selected person will report to the Interdisciplinary and Multimodal Section Head and will work in close synergy with the Interface X\-ray/TEM and Methodology groups, with beamline scientists, the Joint Electron Microscopy Center at ALBA (JEMCA), and with the project partners. The role emphasis is on the testing of the microreactor prototypes in the (S)TEM and x\-ray beamlines.


Specifically, the responsibilities will include:


• Executing the commissioning, operation and maintenance of micro\-cell reactor systems for catalysis research.


* Contributing to define procedures for operando and in\-situ correlative (S)TEM/X\-ray analysis services within a network of experts and under consideration of the international community.


* Contributing to the improvement of the micro\-cell reactor system and the development of a true multi\-technique approach that will benefit staff, collaborators, and external users.


* Supporting staff and collaborators in (S)TEM and x\-ray experiments making use of the micro\-cell reactor systems.


* Analysing and interpreting multimodal experimental data.


* Disseminating results through peer\-reviewed publications, conference contributions, project deliverables and reports.

  

#### **Requirements**


The requirements for participation must be met on the date of the deadline for the submission of applications and will be accredited by means of the CV attached to it, without prejudice to the power of the selection body to require the contribution of the originals of the certifications accrediting the qualifications, training and work experience invoked in the CV.


Applications that do not present the aforementioned or required documentation during the selection procedure will not be accepted.


Candidates must hold a PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Physics, or equivalent, and have hands\-on experience in (S)TEM and/or synchrotron X\-ray techniques.


Everyone who meets the requirements will be admitted for the selection process. This position is reserved for those candidates having the legal status of person with disabilities, with a degree of disability equal or greater than 33%. In case of one or more admitted applicants with this status of disability, these candidates will be evaluated at first. In the event that no candidate with the status of disability is finally selected for the position, the selection process shall continue and the rest of the applicants will be evaluated.

  

#### **Selection Process Development**


The selection will be carried out through the competition\-opposition system.


As a first phase, an analysis of the curriculum will be carried out (assessment of previous experience and / or scientific history, degree, training and other professional information relevant to the position). Career breaks or variations in the chronological order of CVs will be regarded as an evolution of a career, and consequently, as a contribution to the professional development.


The assessment of the CV in the competition phase will be scored up to 40 points, which will consider the following aspects:


* Hands\-on experience with in situ (S)TEM \- up to 10 points.
* Hands\-on experience with in situ synchrotron experiments \- up to 10 points.
* Experience in developing and testing scientific instrumentation (reaction cells, gas delivery systems, illumination systems, strain cells...) – up to 10 pts.
* Scientific experience in x\-ray/(S)TEM correlative experiments – up to 5 pts.
* Hands\-on experience with advanced (S)TEM) techniques (e.g.: 4D\-STEM, EDX/EELS, e\-tomography, e\-ptychography, …) and/or advanced correlative data analysis – up to 5 pts.

The best rated candidates, at least two if possible, will be invited to an interview where the technical competence, knowledge, skills and professional experience linked to the position will be assessed, with a total score of 60 points. A minimum of 30 points must be obtained out of a total of 60 points to be eligible.


Provided they meet the minimum requirements and have ranked among the top five after the assessment of the CV phase, at least one person from the underrepresented gender in the division/office will be interviewed.


The interview will include at least:


* Presentation of professional experience and capability to independently design and execute advanced scientific experiments \- up to 20 points.
* Soft skills, capability to work in a team \- up to 10 points.
* Capability to develop innovative methodologies \- up to 10 points.
* Communication and coordination skills \- up to 10 points.
* Vision of the job position and motivation for applying \- up to 10 points.

The merits will be accredited by means of the CV attached to the application. The selection board may require accreditation by additional documentation, originals or certified copies confirming the experience invoked in the CV.


In case of a tied final score, the position will be awarded to the person who belongs to the most underrepresented gender in the corresponding Division and subsidiarily to the overall company.


If necessary, alternates of the members of the selection board will be appointed by the president of the selection process, and the change will be published in the announcement.


The resolution of the selection procedure will be carried out within a maximum period of six months from the deadline for submitting applications for participation.


The selection process may be declared vacant if the selection board considers not to have found eligible candidates for the position although they might meet the requirements to participate in the selection process specified in the offer.


#### **Other information**


Temporary contract linked to the HORIZON\-INFRA\-2022\-TECH\-01\-01 IMPRESS project.


Base salary range €39,350 – €42,982 gross per year.


The base salary offered will be determined according to the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant professional experience, competencies and overall suitability for the position.


ALBA also offers an attractive employment conditions, including flexible working arrangements and professional development opportunities.


The Selection Board is composed by the following members: Núria Bagués Salguero, Antoni García de Herreros Dunyac, Joaquín Otón Pérez, Lucía Aballe Aramburu.
