title: Fractional Media Director (Part-Time)
description:
**ABOUT PHASE 3 MARKETING \& COMMUNICATIONS:**  

  

Phase 3 Marketing and Communications is an integrated marketing services company providing solutions from ideation to execution. Our mission is to simplify life for marketers by delivering the most\-needed marketing services in\-house, under one roof.  

  

A certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and Corporate Plus® member, Phase 3 has offices in Atlanta, Dallas, Nashville, and the New York City metropolitan area. Since its founding in 2001, Phase 3 has been recognized as a top company by *Inc. 5000,* *Printing Impressions,* *Atlanta Business Chronicle, and Nashville Business Journal*.  

  

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  

  

The Fractional Media Director serves as the senior strategic leader for Phase 3’s media practice, providing integrated media strategy, senior client counsel, team leadership and guidance on emerging channels and opportunities.  

  

This is a hands\-on leadership role for an experienced agency media professional who can move comfortably between high\-level strategy, client conversations, team development and campaign oversight. The Media Director will lead strategy across a diverse portfolio of B2B and B2C clients while helping the internal media team strengthen its strategic capabilities and deliver increasingly proactive recommendations.  

  

The ideal candidate brings broad experience across paid social, paid search, programmatic, display, CTV, digital audio, out\-of\-home and other media channels along with proficiency in website tracking across Google Analytics 4 (GA4\) and Google Tag Manager (GTM). Experience with consumer brands and retail media networks such as Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect and Kroger Precision Marketing is highly desirable.  

  

**FRACTIONAL ENGAGEMENT STRUCTURE:**  

  

This is an ongoing fractional leadership engagement requiring approximately **4\-5 hours per** **week/ 20 hours per month.** The Fractional Media Director will function as an integrated member of the Phase 3 team and senior leader of the media practice.  

  

The role offers flexibility in how hours are structured but requires consistent weekly availability for the media team, key client meetings, strategic planning sessions and new business opportunities, with 2\-3 internal team meetings scheduled per week (not exceeding 2 hours total), monthly reporting calls with clients and the remaining time being used on\-call, as needed.  

  

Work will be primarily remote with in\-person participation at Phase 3’s Atlanta office and client meetings when valuable.  

  

The initial engagement is expected to be six months, with the opportunity to extend or expand the engagement based on business needs and growth of the media practice.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

**Media Strategy \& Client Leadership**

  

* Provide senior strategic oversight across paid social, paid search, programmatic, display, CTV, digital audio, out\-of\-home, metasearch, retail media and emerging channels.
* Serve as Phase 3’s senior media advisor for key client relationships.
* Lead integrated media strategies connecting client business objectives, audiences, channels, investment and measurement.
* Guide annual, quarterly and campaign\-specific media planning for key accounts.
* Evaluate channel mix, audience strategy, investment levels, KPIs and testing opportunities.
* Translate campaign performance and marketplace changes into actionable strategic recommendations.
* Lead or participate in strategic planning sessions, major presentations, quarterly business reviews and other senior\-level client conversations.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve performance, test new approaches and expand client media programs.

  


**Team Leadership \& Development**

  

* Provide strategic leadership, coaching and mentorship to Phase 3’s internal media team.
* Develop team capabilities in integrated media strategy, planning, optimization, analytics and client communication.
* Establish clear roles and accountability across internal team members and specialized external media resources.
* Conduct regular account and strategy reviews and help team members move beyond performance reporting to meaningful insights and recommendations.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend training, tools or specialist support.
* Support agency leadership in assessing media capacity, staffing needs and longer\-term organizational structure.
  


**Media Innovation \& Performance**

  

* Stay current on changes in media technology, advertising platforms, consumer behavior, privacy, measurement and AI\-enabled media buying.
* Help expand Phase 3’s capabilities in retail media, including Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Kroger Precision Marketing and other relevant networks.
* Evaluate emerging platforms and develop disciplined approaches to testing new channels.
* Provide senior oversight of campaign performance, optimization, budget pacing and investment strategy.
* Ensure media reporting clearly communicates what happened, why it happened and what actions should be taken.
* Establish consistent standards for media planning, QA, optimization, reporting and measurement.

  


**Growth \& New Business**

  

* Partner with agency leadership, account teams and Sales to identify organic growth opportunities within existing client relationships.
* Participate in new\-business discovery, media strategy development, pitches and presentations.
* Help develop media scopes, staffing approaches, management fees and investment recommendations.
* Strengthen Phase 3’s media capabilities, case studies and strategic points of view.
* Support the long\-term growth and evolution of the media practice.
  


**QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

**Required**

  

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive media experience, with significant experience in an advertising, media, digital or integrated agency environment.
* Recent practical, hands\-on experience in advertising platforms including Google, Meta and LinkedIn.
* Previous experience in a Media Director, Group Media Director, VP of Media, Head of Media or comparable senior leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience developing integrated media strategies across multiple channels and platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of paid social, paid search, programmatic, display, CTV, digital audio and out\-of\-home.
* Strong understanding of audience strategy, media planning, measurement, attribution and performance analytics.
* Experience managing significant media investments and providing senior\-level client counsel.
* Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring and developing media professionals.
* Experience directing specialized internal and external media resources.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation and client communication skills.
* Strong commercial judgment and understanding of agency scope, staffing, client service and account profitability.
* Ability to provide consistent leadership, availability and accountability within a fractional structure.

  

  

**Preferred**

  

* Experience with CPG and consumer brands.
* Experience with retail media networks such as Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect and Kroger Precision Marketing.
* Experience with hospitality, travel or multi\-location businesses.
* Experience with B2B media strategy and account\-based marketing.
* Experience helping build or expand an agency media practice.
* Experience supporting agency new business and organic account growth.

  


**Successful Profile:**

  

* A senior strategist who sees the client’s broader business challenge rather than media as a collection of individual platforms.
* A confident client leader who can establish credibility with senior marketing executives.
* A proactive thinker who brings forward recommendations and opportunities before being asked.
* A collaborative leader who stays close enough to campaign execution to guide decisions, troubleshoot challenges and strengthen outcomes.
* A strong coach who develops team members rather than simply taking over their work.
* Broad media expertise combined with the judgment to know when specialized expertise is needed.
* Strong analytical instincts and the ability to translate performance data into meaningful business recommendations.
* Commercially minded, collaborative and comfortable operating within a lean team.
* Committed to developing people while helping build a more sophisticated, proactive and scalable media practice.

title: Director of Design Engineeering
description:
Director of Design Engineering

  



Who We Are:



Marketlab is a market leading healthcare solutions organization specializing in the design, manufacturing, and sourcing of private label products. It’s our mission to provide our healthcare partners timely solutions with a straightforward approach based on knowing them and their work. Every day we strive to positively impact the lives of the people who in turn impact the health and wellness of our communities.



Based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, Marketlab’s success is built upon a foundation of collaboration, innovation, and the belief that every team member plays a vital role in creating an exceptional customer service experience.

  


The Opportunity:



The Director of Design Engineering is Marketlab's senior product\-engineering authority, responsible for the technical integrity of products from early concept through release, transfer, and lifecycle change. This individual will lead a scalable Design Engineering function while staying close enough to priority work to provide hands\-on technical judgment and capacity. The Director will lead and develop the internal team, determine when specialized outside expertise is needed, and remain accountable for the quality and completeness of externally produced engineering work.



Functional/Technical Competencies:


* Product Design \& Development Leadership: Lead physical\-product development from customer need and concept through technical definition, design, prototyping, verification, validation, release, transfer, and lifecycle change.
* Engineering Depth \& Judgment: Apply strong judgment across requirements, CAD and drawings, tolerancing, materials, manufacturing methods, BOMs, design risk, testing, failure analysis, and technical tradeoffs.
* Design Controls \& Technical Rigor: Drive practical, risk\-based standards for design inputs and outputs, reviews, traceability, documentation, approvals, and engineering changes.
* Verification \& Validation Strategy: Translate product requirements and risks into credible evidence plans, including test methods, fixtures, internal equipment, external laboratories, clinical input, and third\-party certification when appropriate.
* Manufacturability \& Supplier Engineering: Evaluate supplier capability, manufacturability, samples, deviations, transfer readiness, and product changes across domestic and international supply partners.
* Technical Team \& Partner Leadership: Set priorities, review engineering output, coach technical judgment, build repeatable capability, and direct external engineers and specialty partners.

Behavioral Competencies:


* Cross\-Functional Influence: Build alignment across Product Management, Sourcing, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while respecting each function's decision rights.
* Decision Making \& Prioritization: Make timely, risk\-based technical decisions and focus engineering capacity on work that materially affects customers, growth, margin, availability, product integrity, or execution risk.
* Clear Communication: Explain complex technical issues, tradeoffs, evidence, and recommendations in language that enables practical business decisions.
* Practical Problem\-Solving: Bring structure to ambiguous problems, test assumptions, and balance necessary rigor with speed, cost, and operational reality.

What You’ll Do:


* Define and continuously improve Marketlab's Design Engineering operating model, including technical standards, required deliverables, review gates, approval authority, and decision rights by project type and risk.
* Lead engineering work across the product lifecycle, from translating customer and business needs into design requirements through concepts, CAD, drawings, tolerances, materials, BOMs, prototypes, verification, validation, release, transfer, and engineering change.
* Serve as the senior Design Engineering approver for product requirements, specifications, drawings, materials, configurations, supplier deviations, technical risk decisions, and design changes.
* Chair design and technical reviews at meaningful project milestones; test requirements completeness, risk, manufacturability, verification strategy, supplier readiness, and unresolved tradeoffs before commitment.
* Set risk\-based verification and validation strategies, including the evidence required, test methods, fixtures, equipment, laboratories, clinical input, and third\-party expertise appropriate to the product.
* Partner with Product Management to translate customer problems and portfolio priorities into technically sound development plans, and provide clear guidance on feasibility, cost, timing, risk, and alternatives.
* Partner with Quality and Regulatory to ensure design controls, risk management, technical files, material declarations, product claims, validation evidence, and change records are appropriate and complete for applicable requirements.
* Partner with Sourcing, suppliers, Operations, and Manufacturing Engineering to assess technical capability and manufacturability, resolve sample or deviation issues, and define when design outputs are ready for process development and transfer.
* Scope and direct external engineering, testing, and specialty work; select the right partner, set milestones and deliverables, review technical output, control changes, and accept the final work product.
* Lead, develop, and allocate the Design Engineering team; review work quality, coach technical judgment, establish reusable methods and standards, and identify future capability or capacity needs.
* Remain hands\-on on priority projects by providing technical analysis, troubleshooting, design review, and direct engineering support where the business needs senior judgment or additional capacity.

What You’ll Need:



The ideal candidate will have:


* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, biomedical engineering, product design engineering, or a closely related discipline; an advanced degree is helpful but not required.
* Substantial progressive experience leading physical\-product design and development through release, transfer, and lifecycle change, including meaningful hands\-on engineering work.
* Demonstrated strength in requirements, CAD and drawings, materials and manufacturing methods, tolerancing, BOMs, prototyping, verification, validation, risk management, and design reviews.
* Experience making and documenting senior technical decisions involving product requirements, material or configuration choices, tolerances, supplier deviations, test evidence, and design changes.
* Experience working with domestic and international suppliers and evaluating technical capability, manufacturability, samples, deviations, and transfer readiness.
* Leadership experience establishing engineering standards, reviewing technical work, developing talent, allocating capacity, and managing external engineering or testing partners.
* Healthcare products, medical devices, regulated products, or ISO 13485 design\-control experience is strongly preferred.
* Practical commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish necessary rigor from unnecessary complexity while protecting product integrity, customer commitments, and business outcomes.

* Scholarship reimbursement
* 401k match
* Benefits effective day one of employment
* Paid short term disability leave
* Flexibility with work from home
* Generous PTO policy that starts on day one
* Paid holidays
* Health and wellness program
* Employee discount program within our family of companies

description:
**DIRECTOR OF EVENT OPERATIONS \& VENUE DESIGN**

**ABOUT BOSTON ATHLETIC ASSOCIATION**

The Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.) is a non\-profit organization with a mission to promote a healthy lifestyle through sports, especially running. The B.A.A. is committed to a world where all people can access and benefit from running and an active lifestyle. The B.A.A. advances its mission and vision by organizing mass\-participatory running events such as the Boston Marathon, creating or supporting community fitness events, and sponsoring a running club that serves the greater Boston area.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Reporting to the Chief of Race Operations and Production, the Director of Event Operations and Venue Design will lead the physical production of B.A.A. mass\-participatory event venues. They will partner closely with internal and external parties to develop and execute operational plans on the ground, from planning through breakdown, which fulfill onsite requirements and contribute to events and experiences that meet or exceed all expectations.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the physical production of B.A.A. mass\-participatory events venues / participant gathering areas and experience spaces. Ensure assigned venues run smoothly and efficiently, achieving cross\-functional objectives for the event(s) and meeting budget requirements.
* Build and maintain relationships with appropriate vendors to successfully plan and execute events in line with scope. Source new vendors via RFP processes, evaluate bids, negotiate agreements, and coordinate logistics.
* Collaborate with external stakeholders, such as public safety, medical, and transportation program leaders, to effectively integrate relevant requirements into venue design.
* Serve as a liaison between B.A.A. staff, consultants, and key area leads to ensure necessary equipment is secured, utilized and returned.
* Oversee all venue mapping and layout execution, including overall site plans, power distribution grids, signage layouts, and any other visual representation of event plans. Create standardized formats for layouts across all B.A.A. events.
* Prioritize ADA accessibility in venue build\-out and on\-site operations, creating experiences that are equitable for all spectators, participants, volunteers, and staff.
* Develop and manage physical security access points at all B.A.A. events. Collaborate with the Director of Technical Operations on the Boston Marathon access control RFID program.
* Facilitate operational side of event signage ordering and installation. Work directly with the B.A.A. Marketing and Brand team on request intake and partner with signage vendor on execution including both equipment ordering and production timelines.
* Partner with the B.A.A. Corporate Partnerships team on venue\-specific sponsor activations. Coordinate load\-in/load\-out, permitting and equipment rental needs as necessary to ensure successful activation.
* Manage permit submissions for existing and new mass participation events. Maintain working knowledge of necessary permits to be filed and help delegate submissions to various Operations team members. Keep detailed records of submission status and perform follow\-up as necessary with local and state permitting authorities.
* Manage the Boston Marathon finish line build out. Develop and execute a detailed production schedule to include road closure plan, police detail arrivals, vendor schedule and strike plan.
* Collaborate with the Technical Course Director to develop any new mass\-participatory events for the B.A.A. Identify and design viable event venues alongside newly designed courses that can effectively hold the race capacity and deliver on event goals.
* Build and manage venue sites with sustainability as a core operational priority. Evaluate and implement opportunities to incorporate more environmentally responsible products, materials, and practices into event operations. Oversee waste diversion tracking and reporting in partnership with waste management vendors to measure performance, identify areas for improvement, and support the Boston Athletic Association's commitment to achieving a carbon\-neutral footprint by 2030\.
* Solicit and leverage feedback for venue improvements from stakeholders, such as participants and partners.
* Other related duties as assigned.

We respect this when we review applications and take a broad look at the experience of each applicant. We want to get to know you and the unique strengths you will bring to the work. * 5\-7 years of related work experience as a venue manager and/or in endurance event operations – with a record of designing and facilitating excellent operational and event outcomes.

* Exceptional relationship management and influencing skills; able to build and maintain relationships with a diverse set of constituents. Strong customer service abilities.
* Excellent planning and organizational skills, with an ability to prioritize in advance and in the moment.
* Demonstrated success in helping to advance diversity, equity, inclusion, and/or accessibility. Knowledge of ADA standards and accessible design.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 tools, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; as well Advanced skill in the area of as SketchUp and Layout – CAD based mapping software. 3D and 2D rendering capabilities.
* Experience in Salesforce a plus.
* Readiness for on\-site event work, including extended time on feet, working outdoors in variable weather, and assisting with equipment setup, load\-in, and load\-out as needed.
* Flexibility to attend night and weekend events.

**WORK EXPECTATIONS AT B.A.A**

We are a hands\-on team and seek employees who are passionate about our work and service to our community. The Director of Event Operations and Venue Design is a 40\-hour/week, exempt position. The role will require flexibility to work on weekends and evenings. Additionally, there will be longer work hours surrounding B.A.A. events. Limited local travel required.

McAfee is seeking a **Director of Product Design** to lead our product design and systems team, raise the bar for design quality, and help the organization deliver better product experiences with greater speed, consistency, and business impact.


This leader will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, and executive stakeholders to shape UX strategy, strengthen design operations, and integrate design earlier into planning and delivery. The role is also accountable for strengthening the design system as a foundation for scale, setting clear expectations through the levels and skills framework, and developing managers and senior ICs who can deliver high\-quality, production\-ready work.


What You’ll Do

* **Set UX strategy and direction** across multiple teams, connecting customer needs, business goals, product strategy, and measurable outcomes.
* **Advance AI\-enabled product design workflows** that improve concept exploration, prototyping, design system application, critique, QA, and handoff—pushing the organization beyond static files toward more executable, implementation\-ready deliverables.
* **Strengthen the design system** as a platform for consistency, efficiency, accessibility, reusable patterns, implementation fidelity, and cross\-platform quality.
* **Raise the quality of design deliverables** by defining what “excellent” looks like across flows, edge cases, interaction details, content, accessibility, specifications, and engineering handoff.
* **Build operational excellence** through stronger planning, prioritization, design reviews, decision\-making, documentation, and cross\-functional alignment.
* **Lead and influence cross\-functionally** with Product, Engineering, Research, Marketing, Data, and executive stakeholders to align strategy, scope, trade\-offs, and delivery plans.
* **Grow talent and design culture** by coaching managers and senior ICs, applying the levels and skills framework, and building a culture of ownership, feedback, high craft, and measurable outcomes.

What You Bring

* 10\+ years of product design experience, including leadership of managers, senior ICs, or multiple design teams.
* Proven ability to set strategy, translate ambiguity into clear priorities, and connect design work to customer and business outcomes.
* Strong experience with design systems, reusable patterns, cross\-platform design, and design\-to\-engineering handoff.
* Practical fluency with AI\-enabled product design workflows and strong judgment about where AI can improve speed, quality, system adoption, and implementation readiness versus where human craft must lead.
* Track record of raising design quality, delivery discipline, operational effectiveness, and implementation fidelity across teams.
* Experience using research, data, experimentation, and customer insight to guide product direction and validate decisions.
* Strong executive communication, storytelling, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional influence.
* Experience mentoring and developing design managers, senior designers, and future design leaders against clear level expectations.
* Commitment to inclusive design, accessibility, privacy, trust, and responsible AI practices.

Success Looks Like

* Teams deliver higher\-quality work with clearer expectations, stronger rituals, and better handoff.
* AI\-enabled product design workflows improve concept exploration, prototyping, design system usage, critique, QA, and engineering handoff quality.
* The design system reduces inconsistency, rework, and implementation ambiguity.
* Design is engaged earlier in planning and contributes more directly to product strategy and business outcomes.
* Managers and designers understand what great looks like at their level and have clearer paths for growth.

**Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!**

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.


As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.


We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.


### **About the Role**


We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end\-to\-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.


As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re\-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.


You’ll be a true player\-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high\-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.


As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.


As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long\-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature\-level design challenges \- exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.


### **What You'll Do**


* Lead and scale a high\-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross\-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high\-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post\-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company\-wide priorities.

### **What We’re Looking For**


* 10\+ years of product design experience, with at least 3\+ years leading teams.
* A player\-coach mindset\-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands\-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer\-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user\-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

### **Why You’ll Love This Role**


You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.

* Refuge Outreach Services identity
* Harvest of Hope Market identity
* Harvest of Hope Thrift Store identity
* Organizational logos
* Approved fonts and visual standards
* Photography and video

Monitor social media accounts and respond appropriately to comments, messages, questions, and community inquiries.

Build relationships with followers, volunteers, donors, businesses, churches, nonprofit organizations, neighborhood organizations, and community partners.

Identify opportunities to collaborate with community organizations and local influencers who align with the mission of Refuge Outreach Services.

* Giving campaigns
* Special fundraising events
* Capital campaigns
* Giving Tuesday
* Year\-end giving
* Monthly giving
* Sponsorship opportunities
* Corporate partnerships
* Food and product donation drives
* Volunteer campaigns

Develop appropriate calls to action that encourage followers to **Give, Volunteer, Donate, Shop, Partner, and Share.**

Regularly feature interesting merchandise, new arrivals, special sales, seasonal items, donation opportunities, and customer experiences.

Develop longer\-form video content when appropriate for YouTube, donor presentations, fundraising campaigns, and organizational storytelling.

Coordinate social media content with the organization’s website and broader communications strategy.

Assist with website updates, digital newsletters, email campaigns, event promotions, and online fundraising communications as assigned.

Maintain a minimum **30\-day rolling content calendar**.

The calendar should identify planned posts, campaigns, events, video production, photography needs, fundraising initiatives, volunteer recruitment, community stories, and organizational announcements.

**ANALYTICS \& PERFORMANCE** 

Monitor social media performance and provide a simple monthly report to leadership.

Reports should track areas such as follower growth, reach, engagement, video views, website traffic generated through social media, volunteer inquiries, donor engagement, campaign performance, and top\-performing content.

Use performance information to continually improve the organization’s digital communications strategy.

* Excellent communication skills
* Creative storytelling ability
* Basic photography and video production skills • Short\-form video editing ability

* Strong organizational and time\-management skills • Ability to manage multiple social platforms • Understanding of social media analytics

Experience with tools and platforms such as Meta Business Suite, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Canva or similar design software, video\-editing applications, email marketing platforms, and social media scheduling tools is preferred.

We are looking for someone who is:

Creative

Dependable

Self\-motivated

Compassionate

Professional

Community\-minded

Highly organized

Comfortable working with people from diverse backgrounds

Passionate about meaningful storytelling

Protective of the dignity and privacy of the people we serve

title: Operations Director - Data Center
description:
Balfour Beatty US is an industry\-leading provider of general contracting, at\-risk construction management and design\-build services for public and private sector clients across the nation. Performing heavy civil and vertical construction, our teams build the unique structures and infrastructure that play an important role in how people live, work, learn and play in our communities. Our teammates have an instinctive passion for innovating that is fueled by a relentless curiosity, a drive to employ lean practices and processes and the determination to find a better way. Through Zero Harm®, we are challenging the construction industry’s assumptions about safety. We believe that no level of harm should come to anyone as a result of our business.
  
Consistently ranked among the nation’s largest building contractors by Engineering News\-Record, our US business is a subsidiary of London\-based Balfour Beatty plc (LSE: BBY).
  
Our Benefits
  
Balfour Beatty offers employees a comprehensive compensation and benefit package:
  
Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
  
Health Savings Account
  
401(k) with company match
  
Paid time off
  
Tuition Assistance
  
Employee Referral Bonus
  
And more!
  
  

Summary
  
Assists the Business Unit Leaders and all project leadership to develop, grow and maintain business units, from the project lead stage through preconstruction, construction and closeout. Ensures operational excellence in the execution of all required policies and procedures by the business unit’s employees. Maintains a relentless focus on meeting and exceeding customer needs and expectations. Builds business with current customers by delivering on our promises and creates new business with potential customers in a proactive manner, promoting all our construction services.
  
Essential Functions
  
Project Financial Responsibilities
  
* Oversees the process of creating and managing the project’s budget and coordinates the Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) development.
* Has complete knowledge of the requirements of owner’s contract, including bonds, fees, insurances, notifications, schedules, reporting, and costs.
* Oversees the Project Manager in the development of the monthly Projected Final Cost Report (PFR) projections on time.
* Creates Project Incentive Compensation Plan within 30 days of GMP acceptance.


Preconstruction Services
  
* Collaborates with the project’s operations team and Preconstruction to prepare, review, and monitor information and reports related to all costs involved in developing the project’s budget.
* Takes ownership of process of determining the quantity of budget estimates/deliverables to client.
* Supervises the project’s operations team on the subcontracting process, which includes holding initial scope review meetings, finalizing agreed price, developing subcontract scope of work, and managing the subcontract distribution and final execution process.
* Ensures the project’s operations team develops a plan, complies with, and reports on Minority Business Entity (MBE) requirements for the project, as required.
* Collaborates with project team to establish Mission Alignment Plan (MAP) with the client.


Project Start\-up and Scheduling
  
* Collaborates with the project manager, scheduling, superintendent, subcontractors, and suppliers to create a construction schedule.
* Supervises the development of an organizational and responsibilities matrix at the start of each project and determines the resources needed for the project (e.g., people, tools, equipment, materials, internal and external services).
* Reviews the owner contract with all project participants (e.g., customers, employees, subcontractors, suppliers, government regulators, utilities) to ensure work is completed on time and within budget.
* Collaborate with the operations team to coordinate and deliver all requirements for subcontractors and suppliers to meet project schedules.


Project Administration, Operations and Close\-out
  
* Responsible for supervising the project operations team on project administration and daily operations. Ensure the project manager prepares and maintains the project schedule, milestone dates, and close\-out checklist. Reviews with project staff each quarter and assigns responsibilities, execution, and follow\-up plans.
* Establishes relationships and communication tools as needed with suppliers and other key people to verify all materials, supplies, tools, equipment, and personnel are obtained and/or delivered when necessary. Ensures that all understand performance standards and expectations.
* Ensures that project site and company assets are secure and maintains a safe and respectful working environment at all times by implementing programs for safety and loss prevention, Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO), risk management, training, and quality control.
* Routinely visits all assigned project sites to assess progress, quality of work and compliance with all required policies and procedures. Meets with all levels of


Promote Customer Relations
  
* Builds effective relationships with customers, design team, subcontractors, suppliers, and user groups that reflect and support company core values and meets or exceeds the customer’s expectations.
* Actively participates in industry, client, and community relations to enhance company image.
* Makes presentations to proactively seek new business opportunities through relationships.


Culture, Leadership and Employee Development
  
* Promotes our People\-First Culture and communicates our Cultural Framework.
* Serves as a role model and promotes professional behavior.
* Participates in and support operations training programs (including facilitation \& development of training programs as requested) and commits to the development of project staff and of self.
* May prepare performance and salary reviews for employees, including annual development plans and related follow up.
* Develops and mentors operations employees at all levels. Assists project leadership (VP/PX/PM) as needed.


Working Conditions
  
* The majority of work is completed on job sites in an office trailer or in an existing structure. Due to daily condition changes on construction projects, when employees are outside of the office trailer or structure, they must wear appropriate personal protective equipment as required by the company's safety policies and as required for weather conditions.
* The project team and/or team member may need to move to other projected work geographic locations, if necessary.


Required Education, Experience and Knowledge
  
* 15\+ years of construction industry experience. Depending upon the project size, scope, and complexity the years of experience may vary. Demonstrated ability to oversee multiple projects at a time.
* 10\+ years’ experience in leadership position with medium to large\-size teams.
* B.S. in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture or related field.
* Demonstrates leadership skills with ability and willingness to face challenges, solve problems, and motivate others, while maintaining effective relationships with customers by meeting or exceeding their requirements and expectations.
* Supervises and develops direct reports while prioritizing and delegating significant responsibilities to others.
* Manages essential functions effectively by consistently driving for quality, profitable, safe, and timely results on the assigned project.
* Demonstrates solid presentation skills and verbal/written skills.
* Demonstrates proficiency using a personal computer (PC) and company communication tools and software, such as email, internet, Microsoft products (e.g., Word, Excel, Office, Outlook), Smartsheet, Primavera P6, Procore, digital documents and BIM models.


Preferred Education, Experience and Knowledge
  
* M.S. in Business Administration
* 20\+ years’ experience in leadership position with large teams.
* Experience working in remote locations.

Under the general direction of the Stanford Blood Center's (SBC) Human Resources (HR) Director, the HR Manager will manage HR programs and policies, ensuring that the organization is in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations. In addition, the position works closely with the HR Director to develop, implement, and evaluate ongoing HR policies, programs, functions and activities. Supervises over, and manages workload of a team of SBC HR Generalists and Talent Acquisition Consultants.  

  

**Locations**  

Stanford Blood Center  

  

**What you will do*** Leadership \& Supervision • Lead and serve on cross functional committees across the organization in order to ensure all levels within the organization have a voice. • Serve as a visible, involved and engaged leader to employees throughout the organization. • Participate on committees, special projects, and surveys that involve external blood banking and/or human resource entities. • Coach senior leaders on complex leadership and HR issues including development, engagement, and talent performance and issues which could have the potential to create a competitive advantage for the business. • Lead and manage a department of HR Generalists (non\-exempt) and Talen Acquisition Consultant(s) (exempt) that deliver strategies around talent recruitment and management, learning and development, and policy and procedures. • Manage the work assignments and performance of direct reports. Set team objectives, priorities, and resources to align with Blood Center objectives. Responsible for interviewing, hiring, training, coaching, performance management, and performance reviews of all direct reports.
* Performance Management: • Educate, coach and support leadership with performance management and progressive disciplinary action. • Lead annual performance appraisal process, working with leadership and within guidelines to ensure effectiveness, compliance, and equity within SBC. • Collaborate with department leadership and SBC HR Director to establish mid\-year increases and/or bonuses as appropriate.

* Training/Development: • Design, develop, revise and manage the SBC new employee orientation process, including orientation of new leaders. Ensure that all SHC and general SBC requirements have been met, including HIPAA, sexual harassment, health and safety and lab training. • Perform periodic audits of training files. • Identify, communicate, and consult with employees on training and career development opportunities. • Drive the SBC leader and team member development programs, including needs assessment and design; implement training program (e.g. One Minute Training articles, in\-person training classes, virtual training classes, and curated list of external offerings), and facilitate in\-person or virtual training sessions.
* Leave Administration: • Oversee team member leaves of absence (Disability, Workers’ Compensation, Paid/Unpaid, Personal, etc.); ensuring leave records are processed timely and accurately. • Educate SBC team members on policies and processes associated with leave; act as liaison between team members, leadership, the Leave Administrator (The Hartford), SHC HR Absence Management Team, SHC Workforce Health and Wellness Team, payroll, insurance vendors, and risk management to resolve leave issues; provide follow\-up with team members on claims, payments and related worker’s compensation issues.
* Organizational Development/Workforce Planning: • Collaborate with SBC leaders to accurately assess and design organizational structures, describe new or existing positions for recruitment or classification review, develop and implement succession planning and retention programs, and coordinate reductions\-in\-force when necessary. • Partner with Stanford Health Care (SHC) Compensation to determine appropriate classification and level of positions and with SHC Employee and Labor Relations to execute reductions\-in\-force. • Lead and support leadership in designing strategies and programs to support and facilitate behavioral and organizational change within SBC.
* Hiring/Onboarding: • Manage SBC’s hiring and onboarding process through SBC TA Acquisition Consultants and HR Generalists. • Consult with hiring managers/supervisors and SBC HR Director to determine appropriate in\-hire salaries and oversee preparation of offer letters, ensure hiring processes are compliant with policy. • Ensure effective onboarding and SBC New Hire Orientation experience to foster positive attitude toward SBC.
* HRMS Systems Expert: • Act as lead systems expert within SBC for HR management system (Workday). • Initiate and /or approve human resource transactions for SBC, including hires, transfers, reclassifications, promotions, leaves of absence, terminations, salary changes, off\-cycle checks, etc. • Use standard and ad hoc reports to analyze and identify problems and trends; initiate corrections and/or recommendations for staffing solutions as necessary.
* Compliance: • Maintain in\-depth knowledge of legal requirements related to management of employees, reducing legal risks and ensuring regulatory compliance. • Serve as a primary resource on HR policies and procedures for SBC employees; provides guidance and interpretation on governmental laws or regulations to management and employees, while working with management to ensure compliance. • Develop and document all SBC HR policies and procedures. • Ensure all personnel records are kept confidential and maintained appropriately.
* Comply with governmental regulations and Stanford Health Care and Blood Center policies regarding health and safety. Observe and support good health and safety practices.
* Strictly observe privacy and security related policies, procedures and practices to preserve the integrity and confidentiality of medical and other sensitive information pertaining to donors, patients, research subjects, and employees. Act as a responsible information steward and treats information as sensitive and confidential in accordance with federal and state laws and with professional ethics, accreditation standards and legal requirements. Do not disclose protected health information inappropriately.
* May be required to enter areas where other individuals work with human blood; potential may exist for unanticipated exposure to bloodborne pathogens by splash or spill.

* 1\+ year to 2 years prior supervisory experience Preferred

  

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities*** Knowledge and demonstrated experience as a consultant and advisor to management in at least four human resources areas, including: employee relations, employment and labor law, compensation, staffing and employment, training and development, performance coaching and management, and organizational development.
* Experience implementing diverse and high impact HR initiatives to support organizational objectives.
* Demonstrated interpersonal skills and understanding of group dynamics. Successful track record of establishing credibility and trust with a diverse client group.
